Only getting one star because that is all u can do wish it was zero why horrible experience we figured out tonight why we stopped going here the service that lack of caring al around horrible service took 25-30 min just to get the drink order and the. It was wrong won't be returning

positive.text: Came here for a fun and fancy date night, and it was AMAZING!!!! our server TJ was super knowledgeable and definitely recommended some delicious dishes. super great atmosphere, and a complimentary dessert because it was our anniversary highly recommend!!

Great location for a special occasion - our anniversary! Coconut shrimp was excellent as was the bread. Bistro steak did not disappoint and was super tender. Whole snapper was delicious and a visual delight. The key to it all was our wonderful server Jade. She made it a delightful evening. Ask for her!
Shannon is the best! She took amazing care of us on our special anniversary dinner! Food is amazing. View is amazing. Decor is updated and clean, classy and fresh.

negative.text: Horrible place and ambiance and the lack of wines which they posted on their website they had extensive wines was a flat out lie. We went there for our birthday and left and went to Eddie V's. No sunset either at this place and they gave us a seat in front of a fireplace in dead of summer.
Well... interesting experience! Showed up for lunch but the hostess was extremely rude and after waiting 45 minutes with no communication from the hostess we decided to leave.

positive.text: The service was incredible. Sutton might be the very best waitress we have every had anywhere!!! She made the meal perfect for all 4 of us! In today's world with labor shortages, and some "less than wonderful employees"....Katie, take care of this lady. She is special!!! P.S. The food was GREAT, as well! :-)

Such a wonderful restaurant! Delicious soups, pastas, and pizzas, very authentic food. Lovely open ambiance. I have enjoyed every dish I have ever had here. Service has been great, everyone has always been pleasant and helpful.
Thoroughly enjoyed my birthday lunch. The staff did a great job making sure diners were comfortable with social distancing and masking practices. Kudos to a great staff... love Katie's

negative.text: Looking for pretensious, over priced but low quality food? Come here. Their sauce and cheese are just gross. The crust is overly salt and burned. Would give 0 stars if I could.
Ugh. Not a fan of the way this place operates. Would not recommend. Poorly organized.

positive.text: So good! Pulled pork was amazing. My husband had the ribs and was happy happy! The sides were all fabulous. First time having banana pudding and I was not disappointed. Yummmmm. The staff was also very friendly and helpful. Will be back!

Best pulled pork I've had. Now I'm not from the south so maybe I'm easy to impress. But I love BBQ and it's not my first time seeking out esteemed BBQ joints during my travels. This place did not disappoint. Cool location, friendly service and amazing food. Oh, try the white sauce.

The good: - great dry rubbed ribs - great pulled pork sandwiches - excellent sides (cole slaw, mac and cheese, beans) The bad: - nothing The stupid: - me, eating like a pig, because everything was so good. My stomach forgave me. Ultimately.

negative.text: I drove Miami to Nashville 957 miles to get some good BBQ. What's a disappointment to get the worse dry-up slab of ribs .
Bomb bbq sauce!!!! The portions were good and the drinks were only $5!!! Can't beat it. Don't sleep on their banana pudding either. Side note: the Mac and cheese is what your side needs to be here.

positive.text: Great downtown afternoon spot. Happy hour starts at 4pm. Really good salads and lunch menu BUT I go for the mushroom pizza it's so good. Pairs well with oysters on the half shell and wine or beer which they also have a great selections and theres always a special. Parking here is usually no problem either.

I like to come here for the duck poutine. It is always delicious. I have also had salads from here, and they taste really fresh and yummy. I always come in to find an attentive and friendly staff. The prices are good for what you're getring, and the cocktails are great too. 10/10 would recommend.
Great, unique spot in Downtown Tucson! Have Annie make you a Bloody Mary! It's the second best in the world! She has great service and a fantastic smile... The food is also made with love!

negative.text: My pork chop was raw, waiter rude, and I put that I was here for a special occupation via open table and got absolutely nothing. Heard great things...so disappointed
UPDATE: I'm very sad to see they took the Grilled Veggie and Duckin' Kale off the menu.

positive.text: So good!! Vegan options are great and the whole vibe is awesome. Staff is super friendly as well. Their version of the Bloody Mary is great with lots of yummy toppings. I really love the decor they went with, nice marble type table tops.
The wings are amazing!! Sooooo much garlic. I love it but it does give me heartburn every time, LOL. They are so tasty. Pizza is good too, and the frachos are yummy. But the wings are the best.
The pizza was great and the frachos with chicken were amazing! I can not wait to come back to Reno just to eat here again. Super cool vibe, good music, great food, perfect bar and service was 100%

negative.text: Worst service ever. Showed up with my group and was asked to make a reservation. I make the reservation. As soon as I'm done making it we get turned away saying they can't accommodate our reservation!!! When I was told specifically by them to make the damn reservation!!!!
We never got our pizza via Uber Eats and the pizza place didn't seem to care. So disappointing. They need to use a more reliable delivery service.

positive.text: The cutest little hole in the wall cafe, the store is very nicely decorated and has a cute little patio! The coffee is good (I like it way better then Starbucks) and it just have an overall very nice ambiance! Definitely recommend!

I love their golden turmeric lattes. I can't stop thinking about that dang chive ricotta toast...I want more!! Great seating indoor or outdoor. Staff is friendly and helpful. I feel like they really want you to get the best out of your order and time.

I just ordered the lavender latte with a shot of espresso (otherwise it is non caffeine) and it was amazing! They have a great range of coffee flavors, drinks, bakery, AND food!! I got the avocado toast which was delicious and my fiancé ordered the keto bowl which he loved. Staff was helpful and I loved the space

negative.text: Easily the worst food I have had in a while. Ordered vegetable burrito bowl. Disgusting! Microwaved eggs with a lump of cheese on a side with black beans straight out of a can, inedible . Bland and gross. Good costumer service tho #dont come #canned beans #dont recommend
Yikes, terrible chai latte for some reason. Maybe it was the milk sub but it had one of the worst flavors I've had in a chai drink. Hopefully just an off day

positive.text: Best fried chicken I've ever had! Perfectly cooked and served with a delicious sweet potato mash. I've had my fair share of fried chicken across the south and this definitely tops the list.

Shrimp and grits so amazing! Fried chicken might be the best I've ever had. The drum was so good, didn't even know that was a fish but our server recommended, the pork chop was the bomb, the collard greens were so good! 1st time to New Orleans and this dinner did not disappoint!!!

This is by far the best restaurant in New Orleans! We had the pork chop, fried chicken, drum fish and the fish special grouper. EVERY meal was PERFECT! Chef Philippe personally made recommendations and he was on the money. The entire staff was super friendly. We came back again. FYI, make reservations.

negative.text: We stopped in for a quick lunch before leaving town. The food was good but the service was not that great. We got snubbed for not ordering drinks or dessert. And then for also asking for split checks. Probably would not recommend it.
The food was excellent, but our waiter was horrible. He was negative about selections, never filled up our water, and it took a half hour to get our ticket.

positive.text: Amazing mexican food in Santa Barbara! The menu is great, and the quality of the food is outstanding. What also separates them is their excellent service. The manager, Andrea, was so kind and generous. Our waiter, Eric, was absolutely wonderful, and he made sure we were taken care of. This place is a must try!!

Wow. I can't even describe to you how good my chicken fajitas were. Best fajitas I've ever had. And the guacamole! So fresh. Beautiful live music, great service, and beautiful scenery. I'll never forget the mariposa butterflies that were flying around my table outside!

Best ceviche in town, pleasant staff with a smile and orders always on time. Best margaritas in town as well. Delicious ribs and enchiladas also and terrific tequila selection. Authentic Mexican food, great guacamole also. A+!

negative.text: The location is good, but the food is terrible. Tasteless and boring. And the waiter said they don't split checks which is kind of weird. Splitting a check should not be a foreign concept. Would not return or recommend.
Accidentally walked into this place. Don't if you have a choice. There's no salt and bad service. I wouldn't do it. Keep walking down state instead and find something else.

positive.text: I had a delicious quiche it was amazing sitting outside watching the water while eating breakfast and enjoying my fabulous latte! I'm so happy that quaint little place is like this it still exist the service was great and the food was delicious!

Went today for the first time and was so pleased! I had the chocolate croissant RIGHT OUT OF THE OVEN. It was heavenly. Also had an iced caramel latte which was great and two toasted croissants. The sausage in the sandwich was the good kind. And staff is super attentive. Highly recommend!

I don't know how they get their quiche so fluffy but wow it was good! Would definitely order the veggie quiche and the pesto mozzarella tomato pressed croissant again. The lady working there was also a gem - super sweet!

negative.text: Extremely rude barista. During a time where restaurants and shops desperately need customer support, I am baffled by the behavior I experienced. Decent coffee but I will be spending my money at other cafes in the area.
Fabulous service and incredible food! Bacon Croissant Sandwich and Chocolate Croissant were to die for.

positive.text: Took 5 of my carnivorous friends for lunch today. They had never tried jackfruit and I was a little worried but they loved it! The Cuban tacos are so awesome! One of my friends said the black beans were the best she'd ever had. I agree! Can't wait to go back. Wish we'd taken pics.

Excellent food! Excellent service! This is one of my favorite restaurants. I love all of the jackfruit dishes. I have shared this restaurant with a few other friends, who all have said it is now their favorite restaurant. The food tastes so very fresh. It is original and an excellent blend of flavors.

This food is amazing!!! I'm so in love! I read the reviews here and wasn't sure how good vegan tacos would taste but I'm honestly impressed. I ordered spicy el pastor (I think?) tacos and they were great. It's also a very filling meal and I really enjoyed all the spices and everything else. 10/10 would recommend!

negative.text: What I had was good but not great. Just not my type of restaurant. I have not been to very many restaurants, where you order at the counter, that I like. Going by the names on the menu, I was not sure just what to order.
Was very expensive for just 4plates of vegan food. I came out paying 80 bucks i was like wtf!

positive.text: Great restaurant. Very busy, but worth the wait. My server was kind and attentive, and I wish I could remember his name. I had the delicious blackened mahi mahi. Perfectly cooked and nicely seasoned. Great experience.

Great location, great food! Even though they don't take reservations, the host was very accommodating to our larger party. Our server was also very helpful, kind, & attentive! The restaurant sits on the beach which was nice & the menu had lots of options! Everyone enjoyed their food and we would definitely go back!

Went here 5 years ago and revisited yesterday while I'm back in Florida. Love it then and loved it now! Great food and your waiter was awesome! The seafood was so fresh! Definitely recommend the crab stuffed grouper, cerviche and rocktopus!

negative.text: Do not enjoy this place almost ever. Overpriced food, Bad service (had to wait for 15 min to get water served on a very hot day). This has become a tourist trap.

We were not a fan of this establishment. The portions were really small for the price. The sides were not good.... mashed potatoes and veggies. The crab soup was really missing flavor. And crab. The place had an overall messy feel. The bathroom really needs attention.

positive.text: Love this place. Service was absolutely great! Food was good and the Oysters an atmosphere was legit cool. Definitely a place to eat at when in NOLA. Enjoy and thank me later

Very Yummy! The Oysters were really good and the staff was really nice as well. My husband and I are definitely enjoying the new orleans experience. There was even a local jazz player nearby after leaving that topped off a wonderful evening.

The chargrilled oysters are a masterpiece! I'd go here everytime just for those! The rest of the food is slightly better than average but nothing to write home about. Gumbo was tasty and the bbq shrimp n grits was better than average. Drinks were mediocre. Service was great, especially since it was super busy!

negative.text: Dragos Oysters were great. Everything else was terrible - even the kids chicken tenders were bad (no seasoning whatsoever). Shrimp and grits - rubbery shrimp, dry hockey puck of grits. BBQ shrimp - more rubbery sad little shrimp in a weird peppery sauce; definitely not what I'd call BBQ shrimp and served with pita?!
Food was not good. Super expensive for an over cooked steak and lobster. Would not recommend the Alfredo. The lobster Mac was ok for not having lobster.

positive.text: We love to eat here when we're in town. The ambiance is comfortable and inviting. The staff is friendly, welcoming and very helpful. We had a great dinner- a burger and a few steaks- all tasty and very enjoyable! It's a nice place to get a good meal.

Fantastic experience! It is not cheap, but every bite is one to savor. A favorite for special occasion meals! Our server/bartender (Nick????) did a fabulous job making our son feel seen and loved on his 21st birthday. Loved the toasted ravioli!

Harry & Izzy's have have a simple but good menu to fit most tastes and appetites. The Filet mignon was perfectly cooked, and the sides were tasty including the famous shrimp cocktail! The wine menu has many options and certainly will not disappoint. The dining area and balcony provide a very nice ambiance as well.

negative.text: I ordered delivery. The cheesecake was great but the prime rib pizza and the mashed potatoes were very bland. For the price, i was disappointed. I've had tastier food from food trucks.
The service was slow and the food was just so so...not what I expected considering their prices.

positive.text: I absolutely love it here!! It has the feel of being inside someone's house; comfortable and inviting. The food is delicious and the staff is very nice. As a vegan, with a non-vegan family, this place is perfect for a family dinner out! I recommend the Korean BBQ tofu tacos- so good!

Oh. My god. Why have I just found this place!? We ordered from grubhub- it took forever but YES! It was so good. I warmed up the oven and air fryer to reheat things- we live a bit away. We did a "fun night" and ordered a few entrees and sides and I'm embarrassed to say there isn't much left! Absolutely great!

Super dooper healthy delicious. This place has many food options including vegetarian and vegan. Everything is freshly made. I enjoyed the impossible burger and the tofu tacos. My friend and I shared the meals. Oh there is a check in offer for free iced coffee. I hope to come back the next time I am in town

negative.text: I always want to eat here because of the mom and pop atmosphere, but never truly leave satisfied. The food is okay, nothing to brag about, but the service is awful. All 3 times I have gone, they have been extremely understaffed and I was waiting so long for everything.
Cozy little spot for farm to table food. Eclectic vibe and can book quickly on weekends. I have no real complaints about the food or service, just that it gets a bit noisy.

positive.text: Lonnnng wait but well worth it. Besides, I passed the time with Bluewood Cafe Noir, so no complaints. Lives up to hype and this was the best veggie burger ever. I wish I ordered two! The fries are crisp and delicious, but I liked regular much better than seasoned.

Of the top - the best burger and fries I've ever had. Lacy thin crispy edges are where it's at. And the #Ripfries are awesome. The line wait was a bit long, but it was a Friday dinner rush and once you place your order it comes out pretty quickly. Super friendly guy at the counter taking orders. Will go again.
Long line but the food is very good (I recommend the Louie and Ripfries). Ambience is great and staff is very friendly

negative.text: Food is ok. Not the best or worst burger ever. It IS way over priced for the portions. And, they add a "forced" gratuity on top!
He ate my left overs and I was pissed! Now all I can think about is getting back to Mac's. The service is quick, the food is amazing!

positive.text: This is one of our favorite restaurants. My mom celebrates her birthdays only here for few years now. As always great food, great customer service, great everything!!! Special thanks to Scott M. Thank you for making my moms birthday even more perfect!!!

One of my favorite places to go! I have had lunch, dinner, my office Holiday party, my 50th birthday party... every time great service, awesome drinks, and Delicious food! Nobody better in Pinellas county!

Honestly their food is amazing and well worth the price. Me and my boyfriend went in tonight not knowing it was a fancy restaurant, but they still treated us kindly and very professional. The waiters were very kind and informative, and the theme is just amazing. I would recommend if you ever stop by near (:

negative.text: Long time customer treated absolutely ridiculous tonight. Manager that was on duty must have had a horrible day because he aggressively antagonized us upon arrival. Customer service is everything and I was treated so disrespectfully tonight I have no words.

The owner, Fred Bullard is a crook and I would never support these shady, slimy and dirty business people! He left 20 people out to dry without a job and tried to scam us into signing a lease that was unconscionable! Stay away! Do not support these disgusting people and any of their restaurants or hotels!

positive.text: Definitely a foodie spot. The menu is super unique, but a little pricy. This would be a great place to take someone visiting from out of town. The inside is fun and cute and the staff is super friendly!

Went for breakfast with on a Friday. We got there about 30 minutes early and were first in line but at 10am line was quite long. Service was friendly. Food and drinks were SO GOOD! Atmosphere was perfect! If you are a picky eater not for you but if you are a foodie a MUST try!
Always great food and good service at milktooth. Love their unique entrees. I love sitting outside cause the inside is a little loud for me. Their cocktails and coffee have never disappointed me!

negative.text: Got there an hour and a half before brunch ended. The hostess turned us away and said they probably won't get through the people that are waiting. So they are going to let those people stand out in the cold and turn them away after they wait for an hour or more? Horrible business practice! Never again!
Overpriced with stupid food. I don't want to write more, but Yelp won't post this until I write enough, so now I don't like Milktooth OR Yelp!

positive.text: Love love love this place !! Great Service , Great people ,excellent food!! I Best Place in sparks .

Absolutely delicious!! Small place but was busy when our party of 3 got there. Could sit at bar, regular table or bar table. Very friendly staff with one new girl who didn't have menu memorized yet. Mango island roll was by far the best. Please try it!!! But everything was delicious!

This is the best sushi place in town . First off the stuff are super friendly, the crab here is one of the best crabs I've ever tried. The rolls are amazing. Every Thursday and Sunday they have a buy one beer get the other one free. You have to check this place out it's amazing.

negative.text: Great sushi but no all you can eat mussels? Essentially if you are looking to much on at least 10 prices you'll be shy by 2. :(

what a disappointment. Our Sushi chef Min,Did not even greet us with a hello. We were rushed and looked upon with suspicion because I ordered all you can eat. We couldn't wait to pay your bill and get out of there. And of course, as we were leaving, our chef is that even say goodbye. Do not come to this restaurant.

positive.text: We love this place! I've been here a handful of times and have always had a great experience. Friendly and prompt service and delicious food. Not to mention the drinks are great as well. We love the fried broccoli, the dates with a pig and the porque pig. Great happy hour and amazing drinks as well. Highly recommend!
Great happy hour and excellent service. Julia is fantastic! Trying their public library inspired drink "Elizabeth, departed"! So good! Love Milk & Honey and love the Santa Barbara Public Library!

I have never once in my life enjoyed a dinner as much as I enjoyed this dinner. Jamyn was our server and was extremely attentive and definitely recommended the BEST items on the menu. 10/10 would recommend, and DEFINITELY try their seasonal cocktails (Ya Basic is the best!). Thanks for an amazing date night!

negative.text: Best place for tapas. The only con is limited seating. They also do not accept reservations.

Nice sister restaurant of Alcazar. Good location and vibe. Gets jammed up with people. I prefer Alcazar on the Mesa for the low key vibe but if you are on state street and trying to go that route this place is legit for food or drinks late night or not

positive.text: Came for breakfast as eggs Benedict are my fave! These did NOT disappoint, neither did the drinks. Coffee was great, excellent social distancing procedures in place too. The crab cakes Benedict were WOW! Amazing! The crab tasted so fresh, bursting with flavor and the eggs were PERFECTLY poached.

It was long wait, but totally worth it. Drinks are awesome. Try the Bloody Mary. Our service was superb. Our server was amazing. So nice, and bussed our table which left room for more drinks. Try the Banana Foster French Toast and the potatoes are crispy with great seasoning.
love love love Stanley's!! Always make sure we have breakfast here when we come to NOLA. Fresh, different & delicious. Staff always wonderful. Definitely a must in Nola!!

negative.text: Got here, waiter wasn't friendly at all. Food came but it didn't taste that good either. The sauce was rather odd and not a whole lot either. And for $13. Nawww fam. Not worth. Overall not wonderful experience. and just didn't taste that great.

Honestly, the food Was not good, service wasn't the best. I ordered the eggs Benedict poor boy and it was gross. The hollandaise sauce was cold and the meat was chewy. I would not recommend this place. Do not eat here.

positive.text: Great spot! Bring your family to enjoy good food, nice atmosphere, and good brews. A sweet patio always adds more value to a restaurant as it adds ambiance. Good appetizers, NICE burgers, and a great selection of their finest beers makes for a fun night out.
Great beers, great food, and a fun atmosphere. The free tours are awesome - super informative and include some beer tastings they are pretty generous with. Probably the best brewery food around, too.

Easy four or more. Was sort of slow when we popped in to see what's what one day in the middle of the week but was fun. Solid hospitality. Enjoyed the beers so's all well. Hung out at the bar, played around outside, was fun. Was well tended with warm hospitality.

negative.text: Not pet friendly! You can bring your dog and sit out in the parking lot but then no one to serve you. Makes no sense!

Nothing special about this place. The food is very overpriced for what it is. The menu is limited and food is nothing special. If you are coming here I hope it is for the beer alone because you will be disappointed in the food.

positive.text: Love this little shop & bakery Their desserts are wonderful, the blueberry cream and anything with their homemade cream lol. Cheeses are great. Interesting items in their store Dutch inspired. Staff are friendly. Bread is tasty. Just perfect I'm so happy I found you :) xo
I love their macarons here! They make it so good every single time. Love the atmosphere and the pretty display of all the pastries. The people working there are also super cool and nice. LOVE !

Always a treat going to Duchess! The food is incredible and very well priced for the superb quality. I thoroughly enjoy the house made teas and variety of food options, both sweet and savory. Their cookbook is gorgeous and so well made, I love making treats from it!

negative.text: Spent $50, they got my order wrong for staying in, then ask me to pay for the error. Didn't even get the item I originally came to the shop for! That's not customer service :/
I did NOT like this place. There was absolutely nothing special about the stuff there. I don't think that the desserts are worth the price

positive.text: Honey NEVER disappoints. I've been many times with many friends and the service and food are always consistently great. I only wish I could name everyone that took such great care of us every time, so Shelly, please pass my praises along. Five stars every time. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

Overall amazing experience, they were quick to greet us (even though they thought they were late, in which they gave us drinks on the house). Super informative on their dishes, great recommendations. Ask for Scott!! One of the best servers I've ever had :) he's great!

Excellent! Probably one of my favorite places to eat in Doylestown. Love that it's small plates for sharing . Everything we tried was delicious. They also have a fun drink menu. Very intimate setting as well makes this a great date spot

negative.text: This is really something interesting. If you have or haven't tried tapas...you need to try this spot. Not cheap but worth it and it's an experience more than just a meal.
Cool ass menu and knowledgeable staff. Legit. Amazing presentation and legit garnish make these bite size dishes extra yum.

positive.text: Great food : excellent food price it was super nice! Drinks are amazing overall experience was super excited! Try the fried shrimp and fries . Delicious hamburger is another level date night with my love!! Make sure you tip well ....

came for brunch and was very happy! burgers were great, service was even better (everyone who stopped by the table was super friendly and helpful), great cocktail menu and huge selection of whiskey and whisky. highly recommended for brunch and I'm sure the other menus would be just as good!

I had one of the best burgers ever here! It was a bit pricey but sooo worth it. The place itself has a great vibe and is an cool, little space. Our server was extremely nice and helpful. 100% would recommend!

negative.text: You would think that they would be excited and happy to be opened and operating again! But they are not! The staff is so rude and disrespectful! Shame!.

Literally the worst service in the city. The staff is always incredibly rude. Times are not quoted accurately and often 30 minutes off. Food is great. Service and attitude hideous. Head to Kensington Quarters instead...

positive.text: Amazing experience here. We had a great time from the service to the food. Amazing service and the food was great quality. Our girlfriend had a birthday celebrated here and they went above and beyond. Shoutout to Maxwell for the great service. We will probably be back in hopes of enjoying his company again.

Our server was excellent. He informed us that today was his first day on the job and had a great opener. Victor did an outstanding job he was very polite and courteous. Another server with Justin he also did an amazing job amazing delicious and I highly recommend this place

What a great bat this is! My bf and I enjoyed our time here. We tried their pollo asado tacos, and let me tell you, they were delicious. Our drinks were great too and customer service was also great. Nice place with great ambience.

negative.text: Always enjoy the food but this time the Hostess was so rude She made a comment that she hates it when someone pay cash Never experienced anything like that makes us not want to come back.
Terrible service. The employees are terribly rude and slow. They hire college students that don't care what's going on. Also the food sucks the only good things are the chips and salsa.

positive.text: Went here for a pre-Christmas happy hour with my girlfriends. Great food, great drinks, great service, Rodney our server was pretty awesome. They have a pretty nice happy hour special, as they never disappoint! I'll return! I Highly recommend this restaurant.

Dined there with a group on New Years Day. Easily one of the best experiences at a restaurant I've had in St. Louis. Amazing service. Rog was our server and he made our day, super friendly, attentive, and efficient. Highly recommend this, largely because of Rog's excellent service (and amazing food).

Yummy French toast and the place smells so good! For brunch call a day or a few days ahead at least since they are pretty popular and fill up fast!! Love the area and host was so nice! Such a cute cozy place!

negative.text: The music is good for Sunday brunch. The hostess was totally rude and would not seat us. Bar tender served us at bar then told us we could sit at center bar table then the hostess came over and made us move! We are stuck standing the whole time! Worst service I have ever seen in Soulard by far.
Sunday brunch was awful. Rickety tables and folding chairs for sub par food. Piano player was loud, had to yell to talk. Not worth $25 by any means.

positive.text: I've never been to a brewery before and didn't know what to expect, but this experience was amazing! AJ was our tour guide and he was really passionate about beer and knew everything about anything beer related. We took the VIP tour and got lots a beer samples and snacks. Really great time, highly recommend!
What a place. Great beer. Great beer. Yes great beer. Friendly service. Comfortable relaxing vibe. Lovely place for a lunch.

Stopped by schlafly on the suggestion of a local and were duly impressed. Loved the old brewery feel and were very pleased at the excellence of the brew. The best bartenders in St. Louis. They let you sample beers, they tell you how the beer is made and invariably you find one just perfect brew. 100% recommend!

negative.text: Didn't like. One bartender was an a$$. Food was fair beer was fair but people make or fail. They failed.

The food and service was great. Sadly tarnished the experience because they charged us 8.75 for a Diet Coke. They charge by the glass and don't tell you and keep asking if you want more. It's not obvious by giving you a can or on the menu. Can't give 5 stars for scam tactics.

positive.text: I just got to New Orleans and the live music was already lit. What a wonderful way to start your day!! The frozen coffee was awesome and the Beignets were hot and DELICIOUS!!!!! I'm in love with this little city!! The weather and sunrise is just gorgeous!!

The lines are ALWAYS long, but if you have thirty minutes to stand and wait (outside), Cafe Du Monde is worth it. They simply have the best beignets anywhere. The coffee is good and goes well as a pairing to the sugar coated delights, but the beignets are definitely the start of the show.
Such an awesome place, definitely the best beignets I've had. It's a considerable line, but worth it for sure. The cafe au lait was also great. Definitely unbeatable, would absolutely go back!

negative.text: Came here this afternoon around 1 pm. This place is terrible! Because they are so busy, they mass cook their beignet and service it to you fresh from the microwave, flat and horrible! We took one bite and threw it the trash, that's how terrible it was, no lie! We found Cafe Beignet instead and it was amazing!!!

Definitely a place you need to try because it's a New Orleans staple. Coffee and hot chocolate were good but the beignets weren't great. They were premade and sitting in a bag. They were kinda flat and sad. Tasted okay though.

positive.text: Probably my favorite barbecue in Nashville. I could eat their green beans with every meal for the rest of my life. Cant beat the service and moon pies! But I'm saving the best for last: they have that good good ice. Like that good good ice.

Yum!! So so good! Delicious pulled pork, they give you a lot in a tray. The fries were good. Mac n cheese was very very rich, almost too cheesy (if that's even possible). And they have grape Nehi!!! The best! Very old music, reminds me of my grandpa which I love.

Really good barbecue (that's a compliment coming from a native Texan!) Ribs and brisket were fantastic. Variety of sauces available for everyone. Great ambiance. Really warm room in the back (loved baking in there) AND they are open on Mondays. Highly recommend!

negative.text: The girl at the counter today 6/8/20 was in no way friendly being the place was basically empty due to the covid. She needs to be trained in manners like hello,thank you,no question is dumb, etc. One star only because of her.

Food is great but during covid they're only doing curbside pickup which is painfully slow. Appreciate they're working during this crisis and being open, but didn't expect waiting in line in my car for 30 minutes. Pray this ends soon.

positive.text: Great variety of food on menu great service and environmentally friendly! The hostess is awesome and servers friendly. Enjoyed watching the dogs here. In from Chicagoland and visit here everyone we come sometimes every day! Awesome eclectic beach cafe.

I'll give this place 3 stars as a generous review. The friendly staff and great location make it worth a 3 star review. The food on the other hand left a lot to be desired. I am a foodie and the food here is mediocre at best. Other then the staff and view, the orange juice was pretty good.

If you like classic all American breakfast this is a place to be. The food is good, the staff is friendly and the service is great. Fresh squeezed orange juice, crispy delicious bacon, Tuesday burger special with a nice outdoor patio eating area and it's dog friendly

negative.text: Ew!! Nasty!! There was hair in my breakfast burrito and still got charged for it...never again!! Disgusting!!
I remember trying to come here years ago. I felt very unwelcome I was nervous to even try and eat here. I was with my dog and did not appreciate the gestures and looks they gave me.

positive.text: Such a cute place for brunch, amazing mimosas, and delicious food! They have a great menu with a lot of variety, and the foods are usually easy to share with other people. The staff are all super welcoming and very friendly to further enhance your experience.

I absolutely love this restaurant! I love the location, Mass Ave is so fun. The food here is tremendous, fresh, and soooo delicious. Also, the juice sampler is a must have! I recently went here with a huge group and the service was still amazing. The atmosphere is very modern and casual.

Wow. Just had breakfast for the first time there and it was amazing. Highly recommend the juice flight so you taste a variety. Best chorizo hash I have ever had. Husband loved the salmon benny. Great atmosphere and fabulous staff.

negative.text: Just sat at a table watching the owner and manager sample wine for 15 minutes rather than waiting on me. In the middle of the lunch shift. Never even looked at me.

I've been to the Garden Table once in Broad Ripple, and twice to the one on Mass Ave. On all three occasions, the food was just acceptable and nothing special. I don't think I'd go there voluntarily in the future.

positive.text: I can't wait to come back here. They have an amazing happy hour, lovely service topped only by their amazing oysters (excellent raw and fried). We also loved the cocktails... The French 75 was strong and delicious, the Dr. Orders was an amazing Fanta-like boozy drink, and the ABV was excellent as well.

Make reservations ahead of time. Not your typical walk in restaurant, but more good for special occasions. It is super nice and the food is really good. The croque monsier was REALLY good. Brussel sprouts were good too, but crazy greasy. All in all would recommend.

One thing: the oysters are the best in the town (better than the popular ACME etc). Besides this, the environment is awesome and the waiters are so nice and try to give you the best service they could provide. I ordered my personalized shrimp , which is fabulous! Would definitely recommend it!

negative.text: The worst restaurant I have experienced in New Orleans. Made reservations for their Thanksgiving dinner (turducken is what they offered) but they ran out before 6:30. We ate salads and a couple of sides. Service was slow (like we were invisible) and rude. No second chances.

Disappointing online order. Overcooked schnitzel, missing Mushroom vinaigrette, burnt roasted vegetables. Grilled shrimp salad was very good, tasty bacon. Buttermilk dressing not substituted with balsamic per online order. Very little attention to detail.

positive.text: Absolutely enjoyed this restaurant. Hubby had the special which was pumpkin French toast and I had the yellow chicks which consisted of sweet Potato home fries in the scrambler! Absolutely yummy. We had a good homemade orange juic mimosa with great coffee! The services was so good and they offer a military discount.
GREAT food, GREAT service, child friendly, love the variety of items on the menu. SO Glad we came here!

This place is amazing- we stumbled upon it when Peg's was closed and will be back. The food was amazing. We ordered the breakfast tacos and steak bene. Wow! My wife said, "I can't believe you ate all that". Yes I did and wanted to come back for lunch. Michelle was a fun and friendly waitress. Thanks

negative.text: Coffee is amazing. Food is ok. Got the eggs Benedict is was good but not great. Will come back to try something else.

The food is alway great and normally the service is too but I'm dropping a star because of Jessica's attitude when we called and when we checked in. She acted like we were bothering her by asking a simple question and then was not friendly when we came to check in.

positive.text: Amazing food like always this place feels like home with the wonderful staff and amazing service. Square One has a great brunch selection that is absolutely delicious each item is huge & yummy to my tummy!

Surprised my boyfriend with lunch there for his for 50th birthday... The Atmosphere, food and beer was amazing! Can't wait till we go back so we can sit outside on the patio when it's warm! Staff was great as well.. super friendly!

Can't say enough about this place. The food is awesome. I have never ordered pot roast from a restaurant before, thought to much of comfort food. Had it here and it was amazing. Beer was also excellent. Definitely go there if you get the chance you won't be disappointed.

negative.text: Worst place ever. On par with a drive through liqueur store with an angry meth head running it. Seriously, I have been all over the world and this was the worst over priced place I've ever had the displeasure of going to. Never again.

Waitress in the front bar was about as unprofessional as can be. I am not sure if we were not to her liking. But ordered a burger. And was not cooked properly. Returned back to me burnt bun. Manager was polite. But first horrible experience with here.

positive.text: Visiting Tampa bay was a great experience and the best part of my trip was having dinner here. Not only was the food good but what made it even better was moving my party of 2 out to the alluring patio in the back. I fully enjoyed the happy hour Sangria along with some of the best enchiladas.

Nice restaurant with cloth tablecloths. Beautiful outdoor patio. Food portions very generous. I had special order quesadilla that was no problem for our sweet server, who got everything right!!! She was on it and so kind!!! All 7 people in our party enjoyed their fajitas, burritos, quesadillas and tacos!!!!
Best Mexican food I've had in Tampa. Yummy warm chips and salsa. Great shrimp tacos, chimichanga, quesadillas, and awesome margaritas. Super friendly and fast service. Highly recommend Miguel's.

negative.text: Food horrible . Price ridiculous and I spend more on dining out then any other expense! Posted my horrible experience on Instagram and the responses I'm getting make me wonder how this place is still open . Ervybody feel the same way . WACK!!
Food is not great and the servers are all overworked and it's very obvious and they are tired

positive.text: My husband and I are visiting from out of town and we went here for dinner our first night. It was wonderful! Vince, at the bar, was great and very attentive! The food tasted amazing and we got to hear some live music which was a huge plus! I definitely recommend this wonderful place!!
Fun restaurant spot in Franklin. Great food. Cool atmosphere. And great music and entertainment. Service very good too. Loved the smoked meatloaf.

The food was so good and our waitress was so nice! We got the fried pickles, hot chicken sandwich, sliders, and BBQ. The hostess was pretty sassy with us which was surprising and off putting but the great food and fantastic service from our waitress made up for it. Will definitely be back

negative.text: We had a large group of 10 people and walked in late lunch time. The food was good however the staff had a terrible attitude and the food was slow to come out. I would not go back to this place solely because of the rude staff.

Puckett's is always a hit at any of their many locations. This was my first time at the Franklin location and I think the star of the meal I had this time was the strawberry Spinach salad...YUM! But I do have to say that the shrimp and Grits is phenomenal

positive.text: Love this place! Great vibes and great service! We had Ryan tonight on his first night of being a server ans you never would have known! Super friendly and checked in often!

Had lunch here today and the service outside was great. Our waiter was fabulous and the tacos were delicious. The shrimp taco was my favorite. The margaritas were very good and not made with a sugary mix. I think this place has the best tacos in St. Louis.

Excellent service, fresh salsa and chips are worth just stopping in for a snack. Taco choices were extensive and super fresh. Burrito was yummy and super sized. We will definitely visit this affordable tasty establishment again.

negative.text: Honestly it's a shame because the food they make here is fantastic. Unfortunately, the service was the complete opposite. My server was rude as well as the hostess that seated us. The atmosphere of this place and the people that work here were beyond negative and rude. Extremely disappointed.

Absolutely disappointed with Missio Taco. Love the food, but had 2 of our margarita glasses crack. We were offered to get one of them for free. SERIOUSLY??? Two of our glasses crack and you want to comp one? Very, very disappointed!!!!

positive.text: I've visited Dubu several times in the past few years and it's been amazing ever since! Every time is a great experience. The LA style galbi is the best. The service is great and our waitress Jessica was so kind and attentive!! Please visit for some of the best Korean food in the area!!

We had a great night with great food. The food is delicious, particularly the dish of beef ribs on sizzling (forgot the name of the dish). Then Jessica made our dining experience to a greater level. She's dedicated. Great food with great experience!

The chicken katsu (I'm sure I spelled it wrong) is amazing!! The portion is HUGE! Don't bother getting appetizers because they give you complimentary ones (fried whiting, various types of salads and various forms of tofu). The staff was super friendly and courteous. I've been here several time and enjoy it each time.

negative.text: Food is okay but poor service. When I was ordering food, the waitress was knocking the table, seems like she was really impatient. Will never back for second time
Average food, nothing id reccomend or eat again. Service was not friendlly and even was cursed at by a server.

positive.text: Found this little gem in downtown Reno and it was such a treat! The food is delicious, it's mostly small tapas, but everything comes out super fast, looks and tastes fantastic! The drinks are also very nice, though a bit too sweet for me. Service is excellent. I hope this business survives covid!

This restaurant gets my all time favorite rating in Reno. I loved every dish. My boyfriend who believes I'm the greatest chef, compared the flavor to my food. We had the best tapas. The best service. The best location. I have since brought friends and recommended This place time and again.

Great place! Good food! Good service (thanks, Alex!)! Filet medallions are excellent, as are the clams, bruschetta, lamb and stuffed mushrooms. Basically, you can't go wrong! Will definitely go again to the Sierra St. Kitchen!

negative.text: Waste of money. Tastes okay but not great. Great location. The restaurant half a block away is much better. Update: The owner is a douchebag who attacks people who complain about the food. Typical MAGAt. Spend your money elsewhere.

Haven't been here yet but I have been calling f this place for 2DAYS and no answer. I want to confirm the Valentine's Day menu for my reservation tonight and no one picks up the phone and their Instagram page is useless. Not a great first impression so far.

positive.text: Some of the best brunch food of my life. I live for the lemon poppyseed pancakes, but really, everything we have ordered has been so good. It's a very warm & friendly place, and we love going here in the mornings and to the comic shop next door. A true treasure of the Treasure Valley

So good! What more can I say! Eggs Benny was delicious, Cuban was wonderful and breakfast burrito and omelet were great! We will Be going back! Staff was friendly, prompt, and accommodating to our substitutions we needed for a special diet. Busy place, now I know why. I would recommend them, we will be back! Yummy!

Moe Joes is my absolute FAVORITE breakfast place!!! The service is AMAZING and the food is the best bar none. Very large portions and the prices are very good. I really can't say enough about the quality of food and how great the service is! 1,000% recommend!

negative.text: First time Here!!! If you haven't had breakfast here, YOU dont know breakfast!! Great food and service!! Thank you Hailey n Tasha!!
Overrated. Peppers in bowl were still hard , no flavor. Its kielbasa not breakfast sausage

positive.text: We had a fantastic double birthday party there. My 11 and 13 year old daughter and son had a fantastic time with their friends. And the adults had a great time playing our own games. Our server Sketchy was amazing! So attentive and took care of everything we needed. I highly recommend their birthday party packages.
Love this place. A lot of fun. Friendly staff and good food. Fun food too... I love going with friends and family as skill level isn't a factor. It's all about fun!!!

Love Topgolf usually good service Nachos are awesome just over priced for what little you get awesome breakfast try the burrito it wad huge also great eggs Benedict! Nice they the fans are big enough to keep ya cool on a hot day

negative.text: Was disappointed in the food as it seems they are skimming in the dishes. Used to order wings and get at least 8 wings. Paid 11.00 for six small wings that were not that good. Was sorely disappointed in the food. Don't order the wings if you're hungry cause you will not be happy.

Worst service I've ever received. One server rolled her eyes at us multiple times and made rude comments, then when we were golfing the server up there took my ID in the back for over 20 min just because it was an out of state ID . Just very rude from everyone.

positive.text: If the world could put more love in their hearts and @russellsstl in their stomachs, then the world would be a better place. These Sunday Sweets and amazing weather brings to mind the Al Green & Annie Lennox song, "Put A Little Love In Heart." #bradENstl

Omg! Great food! Great service! Great owner!!!! There were 30 of us on a Navy mom trip and we were so well taken care of!!!! This is the place to be!!! Spectacular food and humongous portions! Fabulous wine. Doing everything right and this Navy mom thanks you!

We had SUCH a wonderful experience tonight at Russell's! The service is always top notch (Clint was amazing and so kind!), food was delicious, and the outdoor tent experience is so unique and fun. It's become the New Years tradition in our family, and always so excited for our dinners here.

negative.text: I was unimpressed by their aesthetic and food. Not clear what the hype is around this spot: the staff was extremely rude and snotty, the food was subpar and the wait was obnoxious. Overhyped and disappointing.
Love their baked goods, coffee, cocktails as well as service! Great place in general. But the brunch menu was disappointing - repetitive and not too creative.

positive.text: Our dining experience was wonderful, the drinks were out of this world and the food was excellent. Had a great night with friends and really enjoyed ourselves. The staff was very courteous and helpful and made the night that much More enjoyable. Will recommend this to everyone for a wonderful night of dining.

Treasure in Treasure Island. So enjoyable we came back a second time - not something we normally do. Great food, low-key, laid-back environment. If you loved Cheers, you'll find the similar vibe here only add in amazing oysters and great crab legs. Loved both visits.

Great size huge oysters for happy hour. Delicious cocktails! Good clams. Lightly breaded calamari. Smoked fish. Great service. Chef comes around to greet and make sure the food is great. A must come to visit & eat!!

negative.text: How does a Chef bring out a cooked Snapper to filet in front of us and it was RAW!!! Really, you do not check temp before leaving kitchen !!!! No wonder why there was no people inside ,horrible .Mark that restaurant off the list !!
This place sux!! Wife got grouper that was chewy and tasted of bleach. I'm a commercial fisherman and this is not what grouper is suppose to be.... Beware of bleached fish!

positive.text: Celebrated my birthday here. Best meal we had in Nashville. Music was great and food outstanding. Attentive staff - the foie grad was good but very small portion. The lamb chops were amazing and a large portion. The Chilean sea bass special was excellent as well. Same room for dessert - chocolate dessert was perfect

Wow wow wow!! Love this place !! From the location to the ambiance to the waiting staff . This is a must check out place . The food was great and drinks were awesome. Just can't rave enough, lice jazz every night and burlesque on the weekends which I wish we could have checked out .

We finally got into this elusive restaurant, initially for drinks and ended up having a late night dinner.... What an amazing meal! Our server, Flavio was GREAT! Super attentive and just an all around friendly person. Thank you Flavio for the great service and making my niece's birthday dinner the best!

negative.text: Do not come here. The wait staff is beyond rude, the food was terrible and the drinks were watered down. My steak was hard. The cheese on the cheese board was not fresh the crackers were stale and tasted like dirt. And not to mention, the bathroom smelled and was dirty.

Had dinner at Skull's this week and enjoyed the crazy and fun atmosphere. Unfortunately the prime rib was not as good as it has been in the past so we were all disappointed. However, I will give it one more try.

positive.text: Amazing coworkers, service, and food, and my mom loved it so much it was the perfect place to take her out to eat. Right when you enter the door it feels super welcoming!!! Absolutely loved this place, and even though it's crowded you still feel a sense of comfort definitely coming again

This place is really good I highly recommend. I ordered orange chicken with white rice and it was so delicious. My boyfriend had pho for the first time and he completely loved it. I would recommend this to anyone that likes pho. Definitely coming back to this place.
They have great Pho, but the chicken is very inconsistent. Sometimes its very overcooked and other times its great. Depends. Otherwise, very yummy and love going there.

negative.text: I'm so sad because I love Miss Saigon and eat there whenever I can. Today I found a bug in my Pho. When I called they wouldn't issue a refund but offered a free Pho. I don't feel like I can eat there again so I asked for a refund but they said they don't issue them. Super disappointed and grossed out.
First time at Miss Saigon and the wings came completely undercook. Disgusting. Food was mid.

positive.text: This is a very beautiful restaurant!! Family owned the servers do a great job and you can truly see the teamwork at this restaurant! The cannolis were prob my favorite part, of course apart from the pasta which was also delicious!! :) thanks for having me!

This is one of my favorite Italian Restuarant's! The food is homemade and delicious! Lots of choices for wine and other drinks! Atmosphere is fun as well! The employees are so amazing and make you feel right at home especially Lauren! Lauren went above and beyond to make sure we had the best dinner possible!

I've heard the rumors. Yes they are true! Arguably one of the best Italian meals I've ever had. I was thrown off at first when my lobster Showed up in a soup. But it was divine. Great cocktails, great service. You're meal won't be cheap. But it's also worth it. We will be back

negative.text: Going downhill, needs serious updating & expansion. The worst service we've ever had in the 10 years we've been going there. Uncomfortable chairs that are in need of repair, among several other issues (very dusty items on the walls, cluttered walls, etc).
We are from northEast...we know Italian food and this food is very disappointing. Sauce is just Ok. We had the chicken parm and it was awful.

positive.text: This was my first time trying an original Philly sandwich and I can say it was delicious, so good you'll want to eat 3 of them. I tried pat's sandwich as well but Geno's won my heart. I ordered the classic with no toppings just steak and cheese. We also ordered pickled peppers with it, the best. 100% recommend.

Sooooo, this place is a staple right? One of the "gotta haves" when visiting Philly. I liked the food but it was just pretty good. I can't say it was amazing or OMG wowzer, but pretty good. I usually write more but if you've had a Philly cheese steak then you'll understand.
They provide great steaks and awesome cheese fries. Server was so pleasant. The place was clean inside and out, you could tell they take pride in their business.

negative.text: Very disappointed in the cheesesteak, it was dry and the cheesesteak was not seasoned AT ALL. The sandwich was made in 5 seconds and it was tasteless, very disappointed, this is a tourist trap along with the place directly across the street! Thumbs down!
If you were in the area and had to pick between pats and genos, go genos but if you can wait and go to some other place leave!! Its not worth it tho they fries were bomb

positive.text: I have nothing but amazing things to say about Good Dog! First, the service is amazing and the servers are super sweet. I always feel at home when I go there. I got the Good Dog Burger and it was out of this world. SO YUMMY!!! I also got fries (which were also amazing) and a few drinks. I am definitely returning!

Checked out this place while in Philly for work. It's small but worth the visit. The food was GOOD! Fresh and well prepared. We were not disappointed and if you like looking at cute dogs it's a win win.

Wow! What a great find. Stopped in for lunch ordered the Good Do burger and Wow!! Great burger, infused with cheese and the fries are awesome!! Thin and crispy! This place is great. The vibe and service are great too. Check them out!

negative.text: Great bar, but extremely rude staff. Packed Saturday night, was told to get out of the way multiple times by the host who could not comprehend the fact that the bar was...crowded. Stepped on my toe, said she didn't care if I left. Was the epitome of a rude staff.

Nice little bar but the most rude waitress in the world on the 2nd floor. Let's remember this is a bar people, not a fine dining establishment, you shouldn't throw a fit if someone "only" orders beers and fries..

positive.text: First trip back since Covid, man I missed this place! I had picked up takeout over the past 14 months, but their fresh eggs gf Benedict is unbeatable! My friend ordered the breakfast sandwich with croissant and it looked SO GOOD! Always great service here, too. Glad to be back!
Love love love this place. So homey and classic. The eggs Benedict's are amazing. My husband loves the breakfast burrito. Good coffee. Lovely

Great service the food is always delicious and fresh. My coffee is always hot and fresh with french vanilla creamer on the side . This place is like home to me very welcoming. I like the ambiance very cozy. This our number one favorite place for breakfast and lunch for me and my husband . I love this place.

negative.text: I went in with my family, and our severs were really rude. We asked for refills twice and they ignored us and then they decided to go on their lunch break and sat by our table and kept starring at us whispering to each other. We Will not be back.

Sat us by the kitchen and it took 10 minutes for someone to come by our table to greet us and take our order. The food was cold and not very good. We ordered the Mexican Scramble and were very disappointed. First time there and we will not be back.

positive.text: Not a place to go if you are in a hurry but definitely WORTH THE WAIT. Delicious, fresh and lovely presentation. We are from California where fresh, local produce abounds. I didn't want any deep-fried or greasy anything by this time on our trip. Fully satisfied with this clean little delightful spot.

Wow wow wow. This little breakfast place just blew my mind. The food is all homemade and absolutely delicious. If you are a scone person, you must try theirs, it is soft and warm. The staff is very nice and accommodating. Our hostess Stacy was so so sweet and accommodating. Her sense of humor is great

One of the best breakfasts I've had! Definitely the best waffles I've had!! You could tell it was fresh and great quality. will be back when I come back to the area! & the ladies inside were super nice! :)

negative.text: Incredibly long wait for a table. Didn't seem like hostess knew what she was doing. Very slow to seat you. Food was average nothing great. We will not be back.
Service is terrible! There were two open tables. We requested the one by the window. We were told a large party was coming in. It was a table that sat four. We knew at that point we were not welcome.

positive.text: This place ROCKS! Amazing pizza, great location, and friendly service. I always enjoy myself here and it has only gotten better through the years. Also, Dave's responses to the haters on here are the best; keep at it Dave! Don't let those losers push you around.

Amazing pizza, enough cheese to feed a small army. Have never been able to eat more than two slices before being super full and happy. Pizza pairs perfectly with a day on the couch! Pick up tastes just as great as eating it in the pub.

I've never eaten here but Dave's clapbacks are worth 5 stars. I'm definitely making this my next dinner destination. Slow service noted, but the food reviews are fantastic so I'll clear my schedule to enjoy a proper pizza experience. See ya soon!

negative.text: This used to be my favorite place but yesterday was the worst experience ever. The pizza had no sauce and the cheese leaked all over the the outside of the pizza in the box. Sad to say this place isn't the same after they renovated.

WTF happened? The pizza is unedible the cardboard box had more flavor, the pie itself was so dense with soooo much dough you actually could not slice it the taste was that of cardboard covered with pepper! I loved Blackthorn years ago but now they are bad, I hope they can come back......geeeeeez that was bad

positive.text: Great food and great service. Definitely a great food find! Fajitas are amazing as well as burritos and tacos. Good atmosphere. We eat here about once a week now that we found it. One of our go tos for a good dinner.

Macho tequilas has one of the better chimis in town. It's in a bit of a rougher part of town but inside is very welcoming and you can say the same for the staff. Margaritas are good as well especially the flavored ones. The prices are pretty fair and I'd say the food is pretty authentic.

First time visiting this establishment. Great little hole in the wall! Loved Danny Boy's old school kitchen. Great service, and excellent food. I had the carnitas, and my wife had the enchiladas. Very, very, very good food! Definitely will be visiting again in the near future.

negative.text: Mediocre food especially for the price- burrito and a drink $15... for lunch?? Yikes Doubt I would return before trying one of the other 1000 Mexican restaurants in town.
Finding out a place isn't open, even after calling and having no voicemail notification is pretty unprofessional.

positive.text: Love this place! Great happy hour, awesome beer and cocktail selection. The food is delicious- my favorites are the whiteout pizza and the chicken caesar wrap! And, of course, the best part is the service: always friendly and kind, they really go out of their way to make you feel welcome :) Definitely recommend!!

Amazing place! Love everything there, yummy appetizers! Best Margaritas and of course Beer. Great service, everyone is super friendly and always make you feel good! I strongly recommend, been going there for years.

Love Love Love the SB Brew Co. Owners, Wayne and Michelle are both passionate about their business and are amazing at keeping both the front restaurant and back lounge a great experience. Perfect to watch sports game at and obsessed with their Boneless Wings and their homemade Raspberry Balsamic salad dressing!

negative.text: The worst customer service I've ever dealt with. Not only was our waitress rude, she was short and terrible at communicating. She only stayed at the table for a sum of 5 minutes total. Messed up our Groupon and then blamed us. She should be fired. Terrible customer service, won't come back.

Bad food. Really bad service. Our waitress ignored us most of the night and chatted with her coworkers constantly. The pizza was gross, almost inedible. The nachos were also terrible. Beer was ok. Won't be back.

positive.text: I have only visited once, but the time I went it was absolutely amazing. My husband and I were craving sushi and burgers, so we chose this place because they have both. I'm not sure how a restaurant can have the best burger AND the best sushi, but they did. The drinks were great too. Right down in CWE, perfect.

Drinks were expensive but delicious. The sushi roll tasted amazing; however, the rice was less sticky...and more mushy. Wasn't a huge deal, as the roll still tasted great. I was pretty impressed that the spicy mayo actually had a kick to it, unlike many sushi spots in town.
Great location. The staff was cool, quite pleasant. I had happy hour fried mushrooms, veggie burger & sweet potato fries. It was all delicious. Good eats

negative.text: If I want just a drink I'll come back and only sit at the bar. If I want food with a drink will not be back. Service was horrible waited very long for everything then had to ask for anything we need ex. Napkin, silver ware, water just the normal. Cool idea of a place but not super impressed.
This was the worst sushi I've had in awhile. The spicy tuna roll was gross and had a barbecue taste to it. Everything was kind of overpriced and the service was very slow.

positive.text: Awesome spot. Great atmosphere, great food. Salsa and guac were awesome. All the drinks we had were great. Our bartender Gabriel was as good as they come, great service and very friendly. Highly recommended and will definitely come again

First visit during lunch. Menu has great items. I tried the highly recommended skillet tacos. This is a great dish especially if you love cheese. Service was fantastic, Lupe was our server and was great. She made great recommendations and was very friendly.

First time checking this place out! Great decor and ambiance, amazing happy hour deals ($5 La Casa Margarita are great frozen margaritas), service was awesome. Really enjoyed the Flautas de Pollo as well. Will be hanging at this spot more often!

negative.text: These must be paid reviews - this is by far the absolute worst Mexican place I've ever eaten at. Our entire table with guest in from out of town were shocked at how bad, the food and service was. There is NO CHANCE I'll ever revisit this place again.
Food was cold. Everything was bland sizzling plate was cold & soggy, margarita tasted bitter. Worst food I've had in a while.

positive.text: Delicious Ramen. Good pricing.. great service awesome resturant. Definitely a unique place and overall a great place to dine n chat. Great place for those who are just getting into ramen. I do wish they had more options on the menu.

AMAZING FOOD! This place is a go to! I love their sticky buns. When the dinning room is open, it's an amazing little room and the service is always great. While being only take out for COVID they are still upholding their amazing customer service and delicious food.

I love this place it is always excellent - I love to try new things on the menu. This last time though I had the Miso Ramen and added pork and the pork buns. The pork in both dishes was cooked perfectly and the miso broth was both savory and salty. I highly recommend visiting if you are near and like ramen.

negative.text: No baby allowed ! Trying to make a wait list and the manager told us that we cannot bring our baby because of hot soup. Come on this is ridiculous policy that we have ever known. You are not the only restaurant sell ramen and hot soup. 5 people need to sit at the bar area. This is really bad experience

Sick place the food here is delish Really makes you feel like you're in a different place once you step in. Very homey atmosphere. My only complaint is that during busy hours it can get a bit crowded but everything else about this place is bomb

positive.text: Amazing ! Food was delicious! Oysters, clams and octopus appetizers for the table. Shaun was the best! Efficient and accurate. Filet cooked perfect to temp. Aquarium was a great view. Thanks for everything Shaun! We'll be back next time we're in town!

This place i was amazing with a big fish tank in the dinner area. Everything we had was good. Their deserts amazing! The birthday girl had sword fish which was sooo good! The service was great and the atmosphere in their was calming. Maybe because you can watch the fish swim. Overall a great experience.

We had Easter dinner here. The lemon pepper papperdelle was fantastic. We also had filet mignon, grouper and swordfish. All delicious. The organic greens salad was so delicious . We just had an excellent experience and Angela was so good at describing everything. We had a great Easter dinner here.

negative.text: Terrible food. Fish was dry and had a bad odor. I never have issues with food, I was in the military and eat everything. Would not eat here again. Tried the crab dip and it smelled rancid. The fish tacos were so dry that the fish crumbled and the BLT salad had sour dressing.

No seating unless you have a reservation. Wouldn't even let the kids view the aquarium without a seat in the "main" dining area. They want $37 for a steak in a seafood town. Rude. Walked out with other unhappy guests.

positive.text: Had a great early dinner at Iron Hill. Did not have reservations and was seated quickly. Greeted by our server and placed an appetizer order for the Brussel sprouts. Highly recommend! Food was delivered timely and was as good as it was presented! Safe spot for a lively atmosphere and good food!
Had some good beers and a great dinner here the other night. Scallops over risotto in a citrus sauce. Great atmosphere and a great place to get some great brews and food.

I love the fact that they had the Black is Beautiful beer. It is amazing with a very robust taste. They also make amazing crab cake sandwiches that are full and I do mean full of lump crabmeat. The fries are made in house and cut very thick. The chicken sandwich is also a good notable mention.

negative.text: It was busy and had the worst service ever. We wait so long for our waitress that the bartender brought us our drinks. Then I got food poisoning later that night... we went their for a birthday. The waitress handed the bill to the birthday guy... wtf

Waited at a table for 10 minutes. No one acknowledged us. When we asked for water the person who we askef stated they aren't a server. We waited and no one cared to come by table. No one. Place was not busy, we know why.

positive.text: Great little place for outstanding pizza, crust is outstanding with plenty of excellent toppings. The salads are also great. Very helpful & friendly staff. We keep going back for great food.
Nice ambiance. Great service. Fun atmosphere. Best pizza. Great place to celebrate the holiday on The Hill.
A great spot love to sit at bar... great toasted ravs and rustic pizza ask about the seafood pizza off menu but really great. Great value

negative.text: I usually get the tuttomare but tonight it was horrible. Only 1 shrimp few mussels and noodles were clumped together. Totally not worth the money. So disappointed
Beef ravioli was horrible. Worst ravioli I've had. There was hardly any beef in it. Serving size was way too small for the price.

positive.text: My first time going and it was a great experience. It was a really nice restaurant to check out after the quarantine that offered outside seating. Our waiter, Jesse was awesome. He made sure we were happy throughout the entire time. His service was great. The food was excellent as well.

It was my first time here, and I would definitely come back here. Carolina was our waitress and was absolutely amazing. She was very sweet, funny, attentive and a really welcoming person. Their food was great and their drinks were strong!!! Mojito pitcher is a must!

We enjoyed a good dinner on their outdoor patio on a beautiful summer evening. Our server was very nice and attentive. I had the huerache with chicken and it was very fresh and delicious. My family enjoyed the enchiladas and burritos they ordered. The nachos and salsa tasted homemade and very fresh.

negative.text: An hour and a half it took them to bring the food. It was freezing outside so we asked to take out the food, and the food was horrific. Bland, chewy, and horrible.
Awful. EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. Closed when website says their open (more than once). Awful service. Why I try again is only my fault.

positive.text: Best roast pork in Philly hands down! My sandwich was delicious with amazing flavor, great meat / cheese ratio, and the bread was super fresh and soft. Get there early because they sell out quickly. Take my word for it, you'll love it!
Passionate people who truly care about making others happy. Wish more business's are ran like this. Outstanding! Keep up the good work!

John is a class act, hard worker. But the Roast Pork is the best sandwich in America, Fact. James Beard Award Winner, Fact. Second Best Cheesesteak in Philly, debate-able. Never put Wiz on a Steak, FACT.

negative.text: Unacceptable service. Called a million times during regular business hours and nobody picked up the phone. No way to do online or in person orders so you're stuck on the phone forever until they get their act together.
The service today in 45 degree weather was horrible. I had to call them 18 times for the phone to be picked up and then needed to wait 40 minutes for a single sandwich. Not worth it!!!

positive.text: This place is AMAZING! My friends and I came here after a long hike, and we all loved everything we ordered. This was probably the best Mexican food I've ever had. The service was great as well. The restaurant is very cute. I will definitely be returning again whenever I am in Tucson.
Loved my outdoor patio dinner experience. Great food and wonderful staff. Tucson best and oldest Mexican restaurant!! Isaac thanks for the great service and suggestions of the menu!!!

This was recommended to me as excellent authentic Mexican food in Tucson. Absolutely special! We had the steak fajitas with grilled onions and peppers and the flavors were amazing! The drinks were great and service was perfect. Took home a piece of flan, smooth as ice cream. Wow!

negative.text: Our dinning experience was very disappointing. The quality of the food was very poor! Compared to previous visits, it's as though they are on a shoestring budget. Very sad they are serving the public substandard cuisine, Maria would be disappointed On the plus side the waitstaff was awesome!!

The tamales were mushy. The ground beef taco was odd because it was a salty hamburger patty not actual ground beef. My husband's chimichanga did not taste good either. The tortilla was tough to cut through also. Would not recommend this place!

positive.text: The sushi is ok. It's room temperature. You can get decent deals here. But my family seem to like it bcuz it's super close to home. Crab puffs are delicious just wish they had sweet and sour sauce. Calamari was delicious with lemon and their sauce they give to you!
Love this place. The all you can Eat is a bit expensive, but the buffet is a great option. The food is fresh and good. My girlfriend and I came in the morning and she loved it, so I loved it too!

This restaurant offers a great lunch buffet with great food and fresh fruit!!! The price is only 11,95USD per person!! And we can try all-you-can-eat sushi next time as well. The area is nice and staffs are really helpful. Nice to walk in and have a meal here.

negative.text: The service is horrible. Had to ask for wasabi and ginger 3 times before getting it. The table didn't even have bowls for soy sauce. The apps came out after the food. No refills on drinks. No staff comes by to check on you. This place is wack. Not going to set 50 bucks on fire there again.

Horrible.. just no. Squid was hella old, maybe even older than Tucson. How can you mess up fried food, especially Shrimp Tempura? This place! Extra charge for left over salty,soggy rice..$5. Never will I come back to this dump.

positive.text: The burger was so delicious that I forgot to take a picture!!! The fries were warm & seasoned almost to perfection but the burger I must say was very different and definitely delicious I will be definitely coming back when I get my craving for a delicious burger like that again!!!!!!!
One of the best burger joints in the StL! Had the Coyote tonight. Delicious! Perfectly cooked. Sat at the bar. Great service! Matt L took care of us - including making a flawless dirty martini!

Was in the downtown area and googled best burger, they did not disappoint! With social distance guidelines we sat at the bar and had a great convo with the bartender Matt. Service made the environment and atmosphere very comfortable. Perfect spot for a date night, recommend sitting at the bar :)

negative.text: Wanted to have a better experience here it just didn't happen. The burger was extremely salty and presentation was just bad. The onion ring and bacon looked old af. Shake was nothing special either and they didn't fill it all the way.

Matt at the bar helped us order killer burgers and picked the fire fried pickles. Go by and enjoy the food and drinks while having a lot of laughs! Matt's banter sealed the deal - new favorite place!! (As if the killer food wasn't enough)

positive.text: Staff is amazing and very friendly I love how it is safe place for lgbtqia+ and the food was amazing, my top 3 favorite pizza places for me. Also some top notch fresh ingredients. Very Eco Friendly.

Food is good; staff not so much. Parking can be a challenge but the atmosphere and ambiance are great. Fairly easy to get to and located near other attractions so a good way to kickoff or end your evening. Hopefully staff will be better when you visit. I've been several times and that is my biggest reason for 3 stars

I have always loved Pi! Their deep dish is the best of any other deep dish I have had. I also love the bada bing salad. They have a great variety of appetizers as well. Service is superb. Chris Sommers, you do a wonderful job!

negative.text: Horrible experience. Food was terrible, took forever to get our pizza, rude staff. All in all just a bad experience. Won't be back!

Worst pizza I ever had. You guys lost my business good job. Unbaked uncut tins of sauce no cheese and this was my second trip after first pizza was same. Told me 7:25 pickup on next one and got it at 7:55 only to eat this crap. Garbage can loved it.

positive.text: Nothing but great things to say. They had delicious gluten free options. The waiters were awesome and go above and beyond. Pancakes were great and gluten free! Enjoy :)

Must go. May be our new go to. Great employees and adequate space outside to enjoy the weather and delicious food. The usual favorites with a delicious twist. The seeded avocado is such a great added touch. Pancake may have been the best I've had in years. Thank you!

Really friendly server Coen was very welcoming and helpful. He kindly explained all the vegan options they had which was really nice for me. The food was delicious and the ambiance also great. They seem to be following COVID protocols so it felt safe with the doors open for circulation. Highly recommended!

negative.text: The host made an incorrect order twice. Portions we're small and overpriced for quality. Ham on my eggs Benedict was served cold. Would not recommend. As a Santa Barbara local I am very disappointed!

Seriously!! After reading the reviews also we went out of our way to find this place circling several times because of one way streets and parking was terrible.
