Every time we come to Reno, we stop in at this restaurant. Don't forget to make a reservation (COVID or not). We have so much fun here and this actually a place we can bring our small children and they'll be engaged. The chefs are always so much fun and engaging. The food is good and the overall experience is great!

negative.text: Please do not go here! The sushi is terrible like cardboard And management is completely the worst when I sent it back after not eating it she wouldn't even take it off the check! I didn't even eat it it was not up to my expectations! Terrible customer service Gabriella needs to be fired.

The sushi tasted great initially but made me very ill. Not sure if the issue was freshness in the meat/vegetables or not. This was my first time here and I ordered the Alaska roll and edamame for takeout. Unfortunate experience.

positive.text: Great service, ambiance and good food! The interior is huge and clean. The best part of my meal was the side salad to the veal dish. The service was really great, and the bread & butter is so good.

Everyone in our party loved their food! Karen was BEYOND WONDERFUL!! I don't eat grilled food and the menu was full of grill options, so I just sat and enjoyed the company. Mr. B's was a special request for the birthday girl herself.... Thank you so much for celebrating her birthday with us.
Wonderful Coolinary menu which my husband thoroughly enjoyed while I had my all time favorites: fried oysters and BBQ shrimp. Great food, great service, great ambiance!

negative.text: I gave only 4 stars, because the service was terrible. Karen was our waitress and she was just rude. The food was excellent, but this was the worst service I have had all week being in New Orleans.

Don't go to Brian the bartender. The server let us in at almost closing time. Had Brian the bartender and asked if he could make a Hurricane. He threw the bartender book at a us. He was so rude and sarcastic about everything we asked him. Not worth the price of drinks. Don't go.

positive.text: I truly love Grimaldi's. I have a holiday to celebrate it. It's great consistent pizza, but it's not the craziest best pizza I've ever had. I have never been disappointed from Grimaldi's. Love their pizzas and calzones are where it's at. 8/10. Super yummy. Great consistent pizza and always wonderful service.

Great customer service. Shayna was our server. She was awesome! Made great recommendations! We had the brushetta which was yummy. The pizzas are brick oven goodness! We had the don with added ricotta and mushrooms. So good!! Hubbs had the tiramsu with he loved. This is definitely our new pizza place.

They have very good pizza, nice staff, nice ambiance, yummy salads and dessert as well. We always get a white pizza and the brick-oven aspect gives their crust such nice flavor. Their birthday reward is definitely worth it. They have a nice variety of beer on tap and a nice wine selection. They can get a little pricey.

negative.text: Probably the worst pizza in Nevada. Overpriced, toppings look to be a few years old, burned, lousy service. Not sure why anyone would go back here. Just avoid this garbage. Frozen grocery store pizza is 1000 times better and I can't stand frozen pizza.
Worst takeout pizza I ever had. Picked it up 5 mins. before scheduled pickup and it was cold. Heated it up but was terrible. Never again will they get my biz!

positive.text: My favorite sushi remains my favorite, hands down the most consistent, most professional, most courteous, most delicious, most feel like you are a valued customer sushi in Reno. And tonight a Saba roll, who makes a Saba roll, Hinoki does !! Why because Hinoki is the BEST!!

The sushi here was very delicious! All you can eat sushi for lunch well worth it! The Yellowtail literally melted in my mouth! Sushi rolls were amazing. Not too much sauce and it was perfect. Service was great. My waitress was on top of everything. Definitely will be coming back.

Best sushi in Reno. The fish was fantastic quality, and the variety of unique rolls satisfied everyone's preferences. I loved the Yo-yo roll, the Caterpillar Roll, and the Ceviche roll. The all you can eat is such a great deal, would definitely recommend.

negative.text: Kinda of assumed there was no wait time. Called in and was told 5 mins before. Made it there in 3 minutes to get 25 minute wait time. WTH never again you guys lost me as a customer fir that.
I've never experienced something so bad to where I'd rather pay extra than eat what I had left.

positive.text: Delicious and good service!!!! The waitress is amazing bummed I forgot her name, the food is super yummy! I love it because it's not ordinary I had the best watermelon salad with goat cheese and pork belly so different, so so so delicious!!!!

Sit in the bar!!! Amazing cocktails, friendly and happy bartenders! The twice fried fries were so yummy, special sauce was cajun or seasoned perfectly. Hubby had the gumbo, be sure to get the crawfish added! The wife had the drunken angel - incredible!! Amber and daughter nice job!

Wow wow wow, blown away with the pork belly watermelon salad! The drinks are handcrafted and made with care. I was very impressed and will definitely be back next time we're in Tucson - so glad we listened to other yelps!!

negative.text: Adequate. Friendly staff that are very attentive to your needs. Food was average but perhaps I hit it on the wrong night.

Too difficult making reservations. Too sad!!! The times are very limited. Unfortunately those of us who can not quite navigate and understand the wait list, we are out of luck. Encourage an easier way to make reservations.

positive.text: An amazing way to end our Florida vacation!!! Do yourself a favor and come here!!! Food is excellent!!! Service is great and the live band was amazing!!!! Soooo good! The margaritas whoooaaahhhhhh so good!! I'm pretty happy right now writing this!! Lol

Great food! Ordered take out and it was great! Staff is so nice too. They also are doing a great job with keeping people safe! All staff AND dinners must wear mask! They are monitoring their staff and they have free mask for people if they need one! KUDOS and thanks! If you are out this way go see them!
Loved the experience! The staff was so friendly and helpful. Scott was my friend and I's server. He was funny and attentive. The mussels were superb! The mahi tacos were great as well!

negative.text: Food is good service at the bar. Is the worst in any place I have been. Rude always crazy rude. What do you want two seconds to take order. Never come back to ask and now left shift and no one take take our payment dishes have been sitting in front us for 15 minutes. And still no one to pay.

Good (mediocre) food but loud live music takes away from the whole experience. Live loud cover playing bands really take away from the whole experience of this restaurant. Bad, really bad evening spent here...

positive.text: Han Dynasty has some great Chinese cuisine. This location has tons of parking, great service and is BYOB.... 5 stars. Han Dynasty while very tasty is also extremely affordable, great value. Definitely enjoy their soups. Also a huge bonus is they have a great chili paste allowing you to control your spice level.

Third time eating here and I'm delighted each time. Food is deliciously fresh and authentically prepared. We enjoy Vinnie the waiter who always knows how to help us order the correct amount of food and suggests the perfect level of spice. We especially enjoyed the spicy beef and noodle soup! Service is fantastic.

Excellent experience! The food was great! The service was great! All of the servers had an amazing knowledge of the menu! Szechuan style food, can be spicy and they helped guide us through excellent choices. Large portion size for lunch tomorrow. The smoked duck in real leaves was amazing!

negative.text: Was so good for so long, now a filthy dump with under cooked food. Such a shame it was a gem for many years new cooks and staff have ran restaurant into the ground especially the lady with the blond hair so ignorant and very dirty needs a bath and a nail shop
Very good place. Food is 4 star. But gratuity is forced to be 20%. I don't like it. Recommend double cooked pork.

positive.text: Enjoyed this burger in the Castor burger! Good service too! Loved the fries also, it was clean, friendly environment with accommodating staff and crew. Great place for casual date night or game night. Seemed to be ready for larger groups as well! Great burger!

Oh HUGE burgers! Most delicious burgers in Brandon. The fries were also so good and the staff is super friendly. We went on a week day prior to Covid so there wasn't a wait time but the food was good and well prepared. The decor inside is also fun and interesting to see while having a meal. Definitely worth going.

Ford's Garage is very cool and different. It's beautiful and everyone who works here seems like they are very proud of it. I am very happy that I went for their Jiffy Burger, it had incredible taste and now is my favorite. And employees were extremely pleasant and courteous. Why haven't I tried Ford's Garage before?

negative.text: This place responded to my review. They said go to their webpage and leave my info. The manager will call you. I did as requested but no call back. The response to my review was obviously a standard response with no truth to it. They really don't care about their patrons. Go elsewhere.
The restaurant is empty but the wait is 45 minutes to an hour. I would leave and never come back but it is a 12 year old birthday choice. I would day go to hell

positive.text: Yum! As usual! I love Forty Five Degrees! The restaurant is pretty diverse & I always get great service & I absolutely love the chicken egg rolls & story night martini so I have no complaints! The inside is super chic & plays music! The outdoor space is clean & has a view if you enjoy people watching!

Best sushi in Indy! Always fresh! Safe clean place off of Mass Ave. Great atmosphere and very friendly staff. Great drinks and wines to choose from. They also have a variety of appetizers including the Edamame. My favorite is the Spicy Tuna Roll and the Spicy Salmons rolls. My favorite place for Sushi!

Great prices great food great services! Sunday's are 1/2 off sushi and various $6 drink specials! Everything was delicious and the atmosphere was delightful. All The servers were great they continued to check on our table! They have outdoor seating when the weather permits! Over 5 star experience

negative.text: terrible service. will take you over an hour to get your order. especially on a sunday. slowest service i've encountered in years. would not recommend for a lazy sunday. the half off sundays on sushi is kinda lame as you will have to wait over 2 hours to get your food. do not recommend.
For a midwestern city, very decent Sushi rolls. Went back second time, and would again if in the area.

positive.text: Wonderful dining experience. Staff were all amazing. Sweet oysters, and the bone marrow appetizer was simply amazing. Filet and prime rib made for an excellent 20th anniversary meal. Special thanks to Kyle and Phillip that made our dining experience so memorable. Great steak house!

We sat at the bar which was excellent view of the city. Our waiter Brian was excellent with tips on what to order and service was excellent. We had lobster popcorn, pork belly and cotton candy both delicious highly recommend. The sampler steak was excellent!

We were absolutely blown away by our time at Kayne Prime. The food was amazing, drinks were great and service was awesome! Highly recommend taking time to enjoy a meal here. We will definitely be back!

negative.text: Service and appetizers were great. The 100$ plus steak was not wagyu as advertised and was horribly under seasoned. 4 of the 7 of us were sick for days after. One of the worst steaks we've ever had. All 7 steaks were terrible.
Tried to reserve this restaurant three weeks ago 2 email 2 calls both calls host replied we will get back no response to emails no calls not good

positive.text: Great restaurant! Great decor! Service was great and the waiters were very friendly and funny! Food and drinks were great. Will definitely go back.

We enjoyed our lunch at The Mill. We had sliders, grilled cheese, salad and watermelon bruschetta. All was very good, but the bruschetta was our favorite! It may sound a bit strange but the flavors together are refreshing and delicious! Our server, Richard.. I think, was great! Would recommend this restaurant.
Wow wow wow ! Really is such an amazing place. Didn't have reeervation so I had to wait , but totally worth it. The staff is so welcoming and warm , you almost feel like your at grandmas house .

negative.text: By far the worst food and customer service experience in downtown St. Petersburg. The burger sliders were horrible. Absolutely no seasoning. The duck fries were burned. To add insult to injury, the fries were $11.50. I would have had a much better experience at McDonald's.

Met my cousins here for brunch. Nothing special. I got eggs and asked if they had hot sauce. I was told Tabasco (my least favorite choice) and sriracha. Turns out they were out of sriracha so no hot sauce for my flavorless eggs. My suggestion keep it in stock

positive.text: Went to reef for lunch had some awesome sushi, ate at the bar; Kalani made some really great sushi, super friendly, and lunch time is definitely the time to go! Definitely recommend

So great! We've been to about 5 different Sushi places in the last couple months and reef is at the top of the list now. Shout out to Erick and Kalani, they took care of us. Eric made us some of the best custom rolls I've ever had. Definitely would recommend to anyone and definitely coming back!

Great service! Great warm sake! Appetizers "especially" the muscles & long rolls are on point! Great choice in music along with a view of the Truckee river! I enjoyed the atmosphere my experience here at reef sushi & sake bar!

negative.text: 0 stars if I could. Food is horrible, sanitation is a solid 2/10, management is abhorrent, and service is not much better. Do not eat here
Sushi is good. Service is horrible. Bad enough to where you don't want to go here ever. You might die of starvation waiting for your table and food.

positive.text: A loud and boisterous Italian restaurant of a different kind, in a good way. Feels warm and homey. Love the photographs. Love the creative menu; always delicious. Definitely a favorite and one of St. Louis's best restaurants.

Pastaria never disappoints. The pastas are so fresh and authentic, with great variation on flavors. Great salad and app choices too! Pastaria is great as a casual couples restaurant choice, and family friendly too. We love this place!
Great date spot! Food was delicious and the gluten free pasta was a life saver. Everything tasted homemade. Cute inside space to go with family or friends! Gelato was delicious as well!

negative.text: Ordered Marinara Pizza with Extra cheese. It was too much salty. Informed waiter about it and she just said, "I am so sorry!". No discount no replacement. This restaurant is to costly. Totally not worth for cost.
I should have known, not being on one of the reservation apps it would be a total fubar. First told 10 minutes, then 20, it has been an hour. Teenage hostestes just dont cut it.

positive.text: Picked up some sweets for my friends bday, she loved them! The cookies were incredible! Curbside pick up was super easy and the crew was so nice and helpful. Y'all be sure to support and don't forget to tip BIG to show the staff how much you appreciate them working so hard for us!

This establishment is top notch. The energy is simply amazing! Great service and outstanding food. The next time I visit from Naperville, IL I will make it a point to come back. Love it. Did I say how amazing the energy is..

Have only had their vegan cupcakes and cinnamon rolls but they are amazing!!! Moved away before getting to sample the rest of their outstanding menu but definitely recommend the cupcakes and cinnamon rolls if you have a sweet tooth!!

negative.text: Not a fan.. the Netflix show was not being entirely truthful. Chicken sandwich was doughy and tastlesss, inedible for me at least. Mac n cheese was rough too. Only good food was fries. Curbside pickup is a nightmare. Avoid this place at all costs..
Food is really good, but the wait for your food is absolutely terrible. Even before COVID there would always be an additional 30ish minutes for the order to be ready. Every time.

positive.text: YUMM!! My boyfriend and I enjoy our mai thai but usually take it to go! Still super yummy but we went in for dining and it was amazing! We had the pineapple fried rice which came in an actual pineapple! It was delicious, great service and our waiter was super friendly!!

What a great place that makes amazing food, donated to local charities, supports the community and has an amazing vegan menu!!! The service is great. The atmosphere is great. The food is outstanding. Get the vegan pot stickers!!! Even the non vegan people will fight you for them.
The FOOD IS GREAT!!!! I LOVE WYATT! Best Bartender!! Make the best drinks!!! And everyone is friendly!!!! Happy Hour ROCKS!!!!

negative.text: Dark and dingy. We reserved for dinner after reading that all staff will be masked. But wasn't the case at all. Flies inside bothered us throughout our meal. Food was ok. The server forgot to tell us there was no sushi until we started ordering. Food service was slow. Nothing to write home about. Disappointed.
Update. Sushi bad, pad tai, not good, and kimchi rice very average. Service was slow. Not much good to say really

positive.text: This is probably my favorite place in IV! They have the best beer, food, and people! Jessica was super sweet and make the best vegan pizza I've had! I felt comfortable and welcomed the whole time, I will definitely be back since they have such awesome events like pint night and trivia night!

I ordered a pizza from Woodstock's, and not only was it delicious but the delivery driver was fantastic. Natalie was at my place very quickly and the food was still plenty warm. She was super friendly at the door and even wore a mask and gloves. Definitely will be ordering from Woodstock's again!

This place had great quality pizza and a lot of flexibility in choices. Chicken wings are super good, and I was really pleasantly surprised that, when they accidentally gave away my wings, they gave me both my original order and the mistaken order of wings. Overall, pleasant staff and great food.

negative.text: Let's start with the fact that we recieved the wrong pizza, the pizza we did get was not hot nor was fresh tasting. Pizza was dry with too much sauce. Antipasti salad was ok with stale croutons. Overall, a poor visit. We don't frequent this place and prob won't return. Service was good/friendly.

We made a stop in Santa Barbara and order some of this pizza and oh my! It so bland and what's up with the tucked in? There was a lot of sauce under the crust it was just bad. I will not order again and I definitely don't recommend it.

positive.text: We just hosted our company holiday party at Punch Bowl Social. It was perfect! The servers Marcus and Spencer were great! They were very attentive and were always around if someone needed a drink. Food was good as well! The holiday lodge was a perfect setting for a holiday party. Thank you!
This dude Carter is a win! He's really cool and friendly. Recommended the best food and was a great host. The food here is good and the atmosphere is dope. Carter is the shit thanks again man.

We have hosted our holiday party here two years in a row and will continue to tradition. Fun games, great atmosphere, delicious food, and the best service. We had Bowtie Mike taking care of this year and he was phenomenal. The drinks were flowing and he stayed on top of it all. Thank you Mike!

negative.text: Came in for brunch and were seated quickly. We sat with water for ten minutes before someone came over. Once we got our food it was 45 minutes before anyone returned. We had to find someone's attention for our bill because we sat for 30 minutes after being finished. Terrible service

Not great, we came here with friends. We got a punch that wasn't very good and they gave us different size cups for the punch which was overpriced. All of the games and karaoke are overpriced in my opinion. The food was just alright.

positive.text: Great happy hour munchies. The brussel sprouts were so delicious, and the oysters were nice and fresh. The drinks were nothing special, but were not bad at all. I also loved the tavern-like decor and ambience. I had a great experience here. Everything was such good value, and I will definitely be coming back.

Do you love dogs??!! If so, this is THE ULTIMATE restaurant for dog lovers. All of the decorations and wall art are of dog breeds, however the overall theme is like British like. In any event, it's super cute inside and pretty large inside. The food is superb. The staff is great!

low key expensive for the quality of food but it's still a good experience overall. the waitress was knowledgeable about the menu, friendly and made an effort to converse with my friends and I. the vibe was nice and the decor was eccentric. definitely a cool dining experience for dog lovers.

negative.text: Extremely rude an unprofessional manager. After making us wait for extra 45 minutes from our reservation time, when we asked how much longer it will take, instead of being apologetic, blamed us as harassing him and said 'then go'. I never seen such an arrogant restaurant manager with no respects to his customers.
They don't serve happy hour inside if you make a reservation! This was not communicated at all when we made our reservation! The manager was not understanding at all and was quite rude, so we left.

positive.text: The BEST! The food is amazing and the service is perfection. We had a party of six and everyone loved everything. From the wine to the apps to the entrees to the desserts. Everything was perfect!! I'll be coming back every time I visit NOLA.

Amazing service food and drinks. The 45.00 menu was amazing and worth way more. Mary at the bar was great, Alek and Charles were amazing servers. And the turtle soup was delicious. Must come eat here!

We had the double bone in and smoked pork chop, settled on a bed of smoked cream corn with a beautiful potato andouille hash, wonderful gumbo, a fresh crust salad wedge and Crème brûlée for dessert. The people that waited on us were fantastic, we really love this place and would recommend it in a heartbeat.

negative.text: They refused to honor my reservation because I have a service dog (not an emotional support dog but an actual, registered medical service dog), which is against the law. While their ignorance of the law is bad enough, the manager was rude, dismissive and unprofessional.

The food was good. Nothing to rave about, but I have no complaints about it. The host was not very welcoming and the service was impersonal. It made the dining experience a bit uncomfortable. I probably wouldn't go back.

positive.text: Highly recommend the sweet and delicious Coconut latte. This place gets packed!! We were told that it would be a 30 to 40 minute wait, but I believe it was just over 20 mins when we were seated. We got: Shakshuka - SO GOOD Biscuits - Pretty good Veggie curry bowl - it was ok Hodgepodge skillet - Very good

Sat at the bar this morning. Miranda was my bartender. All I can say is wow. Stellar service, food was amazing, and Miranda is SO funny. Next time you come in, I hope Miranda takes care of you. Also. Management is amazing. Sarah is so kind and personable. 5/5 would recommend.
Long wait, but worth it for the amazing food! Waitress was super nice & gave great recommendations & made sure our order came out fast after we sat down!

negative.text: Food was awesome, servers were horrible. Up charge on everything, which I don't mind, but this was BS. Biscuit and gravy only gets 1 Tbl? This is Nashville, c'mon.

Get here before 9am if you don't want to wait 2 hours! This is by far one of the premier brunch spots of Nashville. Try their croissants to start and some of Stumptown Roasters coffee. Everything that came out of the kitchen looked freaking delicious!

positive.text: Amazing local Italian restaurant. I got the Linguini Seafood Special and it was delicious! It came with pasta, lobster, clams, scallops, fish, and muscles. It was also BYOB and the service was great. Great meal at a great price!

Went here for the wife's birthday and I have to say that this was awesome. The bruschetta appetizers were outstanding. I ordered chicken parmigiana and it was very delicious. Every plate of food that went by my table looked amazing. The service was great. I will definitely be going back!
The most AMAZING RibEye I have EVER had! One of my absolute favorite restaurants, love the bruschetta, fried calamari and basically any special they have. Great food and even better staff!

negative.text: Giuseppe's is not consistent. Their specials are usually quite good, but ordering from the menu is a risk. Some pasta dishes lack flavor. And beware of screaming 2 year-olds. Not the fault of the restaurant, but inconsiderate parents with children screaming in your ear and a generally noisy atmosphere are not uncommon.

Well let's say I'm very disappointed! Friday night dinner...they pack the place and only have one Kitchen open?! Took forever for our food to come. Waiter was rude and very defensive! Don't even care how good the food was...the establishment was way off on this occasion. Won't come back!!

positive.text: Exceptional service and great food! My friend Kiara and I went for brunch on Sunday and received prompt service, and fantastic cocktails. Our server Nicole was a delight! Very knowledgeable, and helpful in suggesting drinks. We will most definitely visit again soon. Best place in Channelside for drinks and sushi.

We did a birthday brunch for my friend.. wonderful service Scott waited on us (HES THE BEST) and Chris Was Our Bartender ( HES THE BEST) when you go ask for them they will treat you right! And their Food was excellent

Amazing view and ambiance. The service here is great and the food is solid. The menu is full of options so everyone will find something they like. Best option is to sit outside and enjoy the view. Sushi is a great option here for a lunch date or dinner.

negative.text: Highly disappointed! We called ahead to see if the buffet brunch was available. We were told yes, but limited items. Little did we know... THERE WAS NO BUFFET!!! Items that were on the buffet line was available to order BUT NO BUFFET!! Lies! Be honest! Was not happy

Refused to serve us water on Halloween night because they were running out of cups and wanted to only use it for alcoholic drinks. No one wore a mask, charged $20 a ticket and didn't even use their whole venue space so it was packed. Terrible experience

positive.text: We came her for the first time to celebrate our 5 yr anniversary. Absolutely everything we ate was amazing! I was so impressed. And the drinks were so creative and delicious. Our service was super sweet and attentive. Honestly can't recommend this place enough!

Always amazing, but especially the last time. Even with COVID they're not letting it get in the way of delivering an excellent experience. Superb food. Wine list is one of best in the state Love this place!
Amazing menu with wonderful specials and the atmosphere is awesome. Love the location and the staff is helpful and friendly. The beet salad is my favorite!!

negative.text: This place is a bust. It's all hype and nothing more. Overpriced and awful service. Avoid this travesty at all costs.
The food is great but their Curbside is SLOW! I ordered my food at 7:45 PM for a 9:00 PM pickup and was waiting at the curbside till 9:23 PM.

positive.text: Great place with a wide variety of food selections. Definitely a really great option for any time of the day! Family friendly with a great atmosphere & beautiful views. Highly recommend checking out the rooftop bar as well.
Great place to go. Not that food is amazing. Its just great atmosphere and eclectic place to go. All best cities have places like this and happy Tampa has one. Parking is a hassle
I cant complain. Every time I visit I have a great time. They not only have great food but great drinks. Its a great kid friendly place to visit. I highly recommend it.

negative.text: Parking is a joke. Drove around in circles for blocks. No clear signage. Finally found parking in a "lot" 500m away which was just a dusty field and they tried to gouge us over 10 dollars for 6 hours parking. No option to pay for less than 6 hours parking. Not recommended unless you're Ubering. What a shame.

Stopped in here with a buddy for a drink. The bar tends all but ignored us. We sat at the bar for 10 minutes before finally asking them if the could get us a beer. In the end we took our beers an left. I can't see myself back at a place that doesn't seem to care about it's patrons.

positive.text: What an incredible restaurant! Lovely for special events but also just treat yourself. Multi courses that are delicious Southern the creative. Thank you for an amazing dinner.

Service was excellent! Everyone worked as a team so that we never lacked anything. It was pretty awesome. Food was pretty good but not the best I've ever had. The best part was the strawberry shortcake. Super fresh and yummy strawberries.

Went the CP for dinner last night! Was fabulous experience. The wait staff we had was top shelf. The food was impeccable. Turtle soup was great, pecan crusted fish was great, cheesecake was great. Always enjoy the way I'm treated here also. I give it my full recommendation!!!

negative.text: Very racist and snobbish place. The waiter was extremely rude and disrespectful. Not worth it at all or you will risk ruin your day

This had to be one of the most disappointing experiences I have ever had. Our server Jared was awful. At one point he was combative. He lied on the kitchen several times. The food was so disappointing. There are better restaurants in New Orleans.

positive.text: Come here almost everyday with my boyfriend for pho. Best Pho place in Reno!! It's so good, service is fast and great, the waitresses have remembered my boyfriend and I's orders as well which is nice. Overall an amazing place with amazing food, definitely recommend!
By far the best place in town!! The Pho is the best I have ever had and the people are very warm and welcoming! The best part other than the people is the consistently!!! Always GREAT!!

Amazing food, amazing service. Best boba in town- try the mango or strawberry they use fresh fruit and are SO TASTY. One of my favorite places and the best pho in town. The rice noodle salad with egg rolls is also a favorite!

negative.text: If the customer service of any restaurant is as despicable as this place is, I will not support them. The employees here are extremely rude. My bad experience here reflects what some others have mentioned about the place.

Disappointing. Service is very poor. Staff never checked on our meal, refilled waters or cleared dishes. We had to walk to the counter to ask for check and found all staff on their phones. Food is marginal and facility is not very clean.

positive.text: Big fan for many years. We love the pizza, but my personal favorite is the Risotto Primavera. The salads and gelato are fantastic as well. Service is always friendly and efficient. We love eating in and carry out.

The coal oven pizza was delicious so thin and crunchy. The eggplant rollatinni was so yummy. They split the dishes fir you if you are sharing. The salads are great. Service was great. Their Italian cheesecake the best around and so are their homage delicious gelato. I can't wait to eat here again

Highly recommend! Best pizza and pasta around. We had the lasagna and it was the best lasagna that I have had. The gelato is also to die for. It is so good! Service was great and the owner is awesome. Highly recommend! 10 out of 5 stars!

negative.text: I'm sorry did you run out of cheese ? I got pizza with about three pepperoni on it, dried out basil and cheese about the size of my big toe. Oh and your forgot my olives. Disgrace. And this is my first yelp review that's how bad it was.
Ordered delivery, when pizza arrived it was very soggy, was very disappointed even after I placed in oven to try and make crust a little less soggy. Lousy pizza, will definitely order elsewhere

positive.text: One of the best delis I have ever found. I had the Big Tommy. It was just stuffed with hot, fresh roast beef and cheese. The veggies were cooked to perfection and the bread was super fresh and amazing. Loved the potato salad as well. My wife had the Panino Fresco and thought it was great as well.
Pretty awesome place. My Cuban was good but a bit sweet for my liking. My mother's Big Tommy was amazing. The root beer was perfect for the sandwiches.
Great place, awesome staff and a great place to enjoy a meal. One of the best delis to enjoy a meal that I've ever been.

negative.text: Best sandwiches I've ever had. Rate 12 out of 10. I would call it fast food as fast as I get my food. But it's not, great place to stop an get lunch.
None better. If you know, you know. Say "hi" to Vinnie and pick any sandwich on the menu. There's not a let down in the bunch!

positive.text: Loved the decor! Great drinks! Friendly staff!! I got a refreshing spicy cocktail and it was delicious! Appetizers were super good too! How about that unique bathroom!! Highly recommend if you are in that area! Great spot ! Will be back.

Love the ambience. The brasserie old fashioned is a top notch drink best around. They took care of our party of 6 with easy. Staff was very friendly and answered everything we asked. Was a wonderful night and highly recommend.

Fun cocktails and a great "date night" spot. Fun for a group of friends as they have a cocktail for everyone. Food is good as well - smaller portions and "tapas" style. Great happy hour on Sunday. Limited seating so definitely plan ahead.

negative.text: Seriously? Too tightly packed, servers could barely maneuver between tables, too dark of lighting, bad music, overpriced small dumpy plates of crap food with an excruciatingly bland flavor. Top it all off with extremely over priced rail drinks used in classic cocktail recipes.

Amazing....I don't know what to say. Look, I drove in from DC, tired and frustrated with Midwest weather. It was my friends birthday so I decided to hang in spite of my exhaustion. Enter Taste...my wine was okay. I've had better Cabs. But the Brussels sprouts, mushrooms and craft cocktails were to die for.

positive.text: Great food, huge portions for the price, all fresh and great service!! Workers were kind, love the style of the restaurant and loved leaving with a full tummy!!

Super huge portions ! Good food ! Super nice waiters and fast service ! Good spot to have breakfasts for sure! The only think that this spot is missing on my opinion is a small choose of drinks , I think I would of add more milk options like :soy,oat,or dairy free :) but will be definitely back in future :)

We love this place! The owners are so friendly you always see them talking cleaning or bringing food out. The food portions are large enough for you always take a doggie bag to go! I love the quiche or I will get the specials always made fresh. I have been going here for over 10 years and they have always been amazing

negative.text: The food and service is "top notch". My mother recommended Frog pond for brunch. I am a bit of a snob when it comes to brunch food. The hash : 11/10 Eggs Benedict: 11/10. Way to go! This place knows how to do it right! Only reason I'm rating 4/5 is because I really wanted a Bloody Mary or mimosa.
Years ago this was a great place to go for breakfast. Now not so good. Potatoes are terrible. They got that tourist dollars so they don't care.

positive.text: Amazing service from Zack, Lucas, Chrystal, and Miguel!!!!!! We miss Dove so much but hope she does great things. Great drinks, awesome service, and they have a $7 burger special till 7/3 that was delicious! Bacon, egg, arugala, mushrooms and cheese!!! The food, drinks, and people are amazing!!!

All good here. Great beer and wine selection. Menu is not as big as most, but thanks a great thing. That means they specialize in something. And they do. Grilled fish. Wow. I loved it. Staff was great. You also get a free beer with your Yelp check in. Go here people and eat.

Superb! We love to meet our friends there especially when it is Lobster Fest. Tercel (? - not sure if I got the name right) was probably one of the very best waitresses I have had. She was so very interested, fast and happy .... wow! Enterprise, see you soon. We are most happy.

negative.text: For the yelp check in they do not honor this - one of my worst YELp pet peeves... came here for the lobster bisque it was also overpriced and not worth it, especially taking it to go.
I was a customer for long time, and today I was very disappointed with everything, staring with customer services, food getting badly

positive.text: Only stopped in for the whiskey cake and drinks but so worth it! The atmosphere is very cool with low lighting and a sleek, industrial feel. Our server, David, was excellent and on top of everything. The whipped cream with the whiskey cake is AMAZING! Definitely recommend giving this place a shot!

This place has great ambiance! The food is good, drinks are special and if you don't know whiskey try a flight! The bartenders are great and helpful. The whiskey cake and fresh cream is perfection and did you know they have a reverse happy hour??? Check that out!

Best brunch and craft cocktails! Also come see Brandon at the bar, he'll serve you up some fun in a glass!!! Authentic atmosphere, amazing food and staff! We come here all the time and always great food. Fun Fun Fun!! A must when in Tampa !!

negative.text: The atmosphere is great but service is terrible. 43 minutes to get a hummus appetizer. For hummus! Meal took over 90 minutes. Short staffed kitchen is what they said. Poor communication overall from server. I would NOT recommend this place. Miserable experience with my family.
Food was really bad , chicken was bland , quinoa wasn't folly cooked , in general food wasn't good at all

positive.text: One of my favorite places in the neighborhood. Great food and awesome beer selection. The spicy Sivan sandwich is one of my favorite items in the whole city. Great place to go with friends, have a laid back date, or swing through for a quick happy hour drink.

Our server was fantastic! He gave us great recommendations and knew you he menu well. Asked what we liked and then said what he liked. Food was fresh and delicious. Friendly atmosphere with extensive beer and cider menu

I can totally see this place becoming one of my favorite spots to eat. I've been here three times and after each visit I've left feeling satisfied. Good beer and food, as well as a helpful and pleasant staff. Their patio is neat and I look forward to being able to enjoy it again once warm weather rolls back around.

negative.text: When are yall bringing back that Pepper-jack potato soup?!?!?

Our family is here a couple times a month. The menu is solid. What really sets this place apart is the beer menu. Constantly rotating, consistently local, there's always something good. Service here is always top notch. I don't think we've ever had bad service.

positive.text: We usually go to oyster house but checked out Devon last week because Oyster House was closer. I looked for another place that did $1 oysters and came across this place, a gem! Amazing place with a REALLY GOOD happy hour and amazing $1 oysters plus a good deal on HH apps.

The service was great and the drinks were really good. The food was good, nothing really special to be honest. Their biscuits were really good. Overall, a good experience just hoped for better tasting food.
Awesome seafood. I love their bread and butter. Their lobster Mac and cheese is wonderful! The food is well seasoned. I also liked their fish of the day. I definitely visit every time I am in Philly.

negative.text: I made a 7:45 reservation and i was told that we would need to wait at least another hour. The manager had a bad attitude and snubbed me when I asked for an explanation. I will never go here again. Worst restaurant in the city. I would give it no stars if I could.

The waitress marissa k. was so rude. We're from Texas, I guess she thought we were poor or something because she did a terrible job serving us. She gave us water but never asked what we wanted to order. When we asked questions about the menu she was very rude. Good food. Expensive. Very expensive

positive.text: I love the endless sushi, The yummy yummy sauce was good. The stir fry i like the chicken and shrimp better than their beef. The tempura banana was good plus all you can eat i had to have some ice cream as well.
First time eating here and we LOVE sushi. Everyting was great and the staff were very friendly. Definitely will be coming back. Our new favorite sushi place!!!!!
AMAZING! Incredible! Outstanding! Service & food variety & quality! This is my favorite restaurant and today was my first time there. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

negative.text: The food is ok but service is too bad. I think I will give them ZERO STAR if I can. I dont know the women who is at front desk is boss or manager but she is so weird and rude..

Disgusting. I can't believe they serve food like this for people to eat. Everything was so gross. I should have known but I was curious. This is a shameful place. You are better off buying sushi at the grocery store than waste your time at this "restaurant"

positive.text: Went to Harrahs tonight to see the ignite show. It was amazing. I was not sure what to expect but me and my hubby had a great time and enjoyed ourselves. The show was great and Tyler was hilarious, didnt think magic would entertain me but guess i was wrong. Would like to see more shows like it. Was great at Sammys.

Me and my husband stayed here for my birthday it was a great experience. Room is clean , casino is nice , free self parking with the hotel being walking distance from it all. Would def recommend staying again if your looking for a good deal , safe and clean surroundings in Reno
We had a great stay at this hotel. The staff was friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable - Gail was especially a delight at the front desk. Rooms were nice and very clean.

negative.text: Absolutely horrible - abra the manager was so disgustingly rude and they "downgraded" our room because they said it was completely full. Horrible,horrible service. We will never be staying here again.
This place is a dump. Old, used and abused. Stay somewhere else. Weird layout, old games, dirty.

positive.text: This was a great find! Oysters looked amazing but went with the Royal Red Dinner and if you like deep water shrimp do that! Jackie at the bar's service was even better than my dinner and Chris the Oyster Shucker was best. I would strongly suggest this spot to anyone.

Very sweet and awesome people. I had the charbroiled oysters, crab stuffed mushrooms and the gumbo. Best gumbo I've ever had. As a visitor from Cali, it was great to get some southern hospitality! Get a gator bite drink! Good stuff!

Great place to eat me and my wife were on our east coast road trip and this was one of our favorites of the trip great food quick service very fresh and clean restaurant! Would recommend if your in the area!

negative.text: Horrible food, shrimp was mushy and tasted old and dry, crawfish were dirty and nasty , my wife did not like to food at all, food is horrible..

Very disappointed!!! Paid $93 for dirty crawfish had to rinse out the dirt literally shrimp was soggy and absolutely tasteless and disgusting.. looked like mash potatoes. The whole experience sucked. Was told food would be ready in 30 mins.. let's try more like 80 minutes... not happy and not returning.

positive.text: Always great food and great service! The fact that Ron himself comes to the tables and interacts with you, shows the pure love put into all this place encompasses. If you're ever in Metairie, you must eat here at least once! Beautiful ambiance with great food and great service!

This is a really solid gumbo spot with very positive and friendly staff. The food was quite good. The place was also very clean. Overall it's worth going back for sure. I tried the gumbo and the beans and rice, both were really good. Their sandwich menu is also pretty solid.
Very good gumbo, pretty good fried chicken, good red beans and rice, great service. We enjoyed every thing here and would definitely recommend, return.

negative.text: Shitty ass gumbo , Should of accepted my application I don't recommend to anyone eating here.

I got crab cakes, brushed off the bread crumbs, too dry. My husband got gumbo. He said the shrimp were over cooked and like rubber. My brother got shrimp po boy. He said the bread wasn't crispy. Great service though.

positive.text: Good spot to eat. Burritos are definitely the go to for a hearty meal but the tacos are excellent as well. Worth the trip. Parking may take time to find a good spot. Recommend the "brah'rito. Ask for Joe as a server, he takes good care of his people.

Great tacos! Lovely waitress! Strong drinks! We loved stopping here, we were seated immediately and our waitress was prompt, had great recommendations, and checked in often. I loved the shrimp taco and chicken guisado taco! Worth checking out!

Our favorite late night food!!! We love mission. We go here once a week, if not more! Late night happy hour is the best. $2 tacos and $2 tequila after 10pm. Great for young couples, or get togethers. Get the Baja fried, you won't regret it!

negative.text: We went and spend over 50 dollars on tacos, and we didn't finish any of them. the tacos are not good honestly i don't recommend . they're over priced and it's just simply not good.

We placed an order for 27 people and we only got 1/2 the order. When picking up the order we asked MULTIPLE TIMES. When we called and asked about the rest of the order they were incredibly RUDE. Food was mad decent tho.

positive.text: This place is amazing. I have been going through so many stomach issues and they have amazing choices for gluten free! Their food is so great, so fresh and delicious. It's pure comfort food. Burgers are amazing. We have been here a few times and the service is excellent. If you want good food go here!!

LOVE Craft Street in Oldsmar! This place has amazing food and such a good atmosphere. BUT the best part about this place is the drinks and the amazing bartender who creates them. Alex is seriously the BEST. She always knows which drink I'm in the mood for, and it always turns out delicious!

One of our favorite places! Great beer, great atmosphere, great food! Delicious and at a fun price point with exciting specials. I love their macaroni and cheese, burgers, fries, green beans, flatbreads, desserts, beers, etc. Thank you!

negative.text: The worst place ever!!! After checking in I was given a "10 minute" wait time text on my phone. 25 minutes later with no text I checked again and was told another "5 minutes...tops". After waiting a total of 45 minutes I finally gave up and left. An absolutely horrible experience!!! Never going back there again!!!!
I feel like there prices are too high for what they give it's ridiculous 22$ over one plate‍

positive.text: Lovely meal located right in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara. Our server was so awesome and super attentive. Our steak was cooked to perfection and all 8 Of us were super happy with our meal! Will totally be back!!

Love this restaurant. It's our go to for a date or with friends. Great service, fantastic food and a good vibe. The people watching outdoors is a plus. Apps and the Cowboy Steaks are our favorite. Great job with cocktails!!

Wow... this place is a MUST. Helpful staff, we were running late due to parking chaos. Waitress was awesome, and super service. The food was absolutely delicious. Drinks were spot on and some wonderful wine selection. Deserts. Well, they speak for themselves.

negative.text: I went to Holdren's for the first time and was extremely disappointed. I made dinner reservations for my fiancé's birthday at 8:30 and we did not get seated until 9pm, around 9:20 we still had no waiter and noticed a couple who got sat after us were already ordering their food. We left the restaurant. Terrible service.

I have been trying to contact this company since LATE APRIL. They overcharged me by nearly $100. I still have my receipt to prove it! The food was okay, but the salad, two lunch specials, and three drinks were NOT worth over $200. Absolutely disappointed.

positive.text: Our second time dining at Fogo. The first experience was good but last night was great! All service staff was attentive and kind. COVID precautions were being followed. Had a wonderful time and food was great. Shout out to Chef Michael who made our night even better!

Fogo de Wow! This place is meat heaven. The ribeye and filet mignon were excellent. I came here a couple times and each time, they amaze me. The cheesy bread is also very good. I highly recommend this place for all meat lovers and buffet connoisseurs.

Service, food, and specially chef Michael were amazing! Thank you for being so kind and good with our children you truly made their day!!! Definitely recommend come check out Fog De Chão on chestnut Street, come visito for a unique experience with Chef Michael and everyone here!

negative.text: Let's start with the bar.. the customer service was absolutely ridiculous. The bartenders were rude, inconsiderate, never a thank you or you're welcome. It was as if they didn't want us there. They were arguing behind the bar .. just a bunch of shenanigans. I'd rather not come back.. maybe more so the bar.
What's the point that requesting a follow up but then nv follow through for almost a month later? Double negative.... what a waste of time

positive.text: Wowza! Yummy! Even our picky kid loves this place. Expect a line and a wait but we'll worth the reward of delicious food and great coffee! Service is wonderful.

Full disclosure: Haven't been to Honey's for anything but their weekday special but for $6.95 it is the best daily weekday breakfast special. The eggs are always cooked perfectly and the latkes are amazing. The service is always quick and they are always very prompt with re-filling waters and coffee.

I love this place. The food and service are amazing. Comfort food at its best. I ordered the challah French toast and it was perfect. The people next to me ordered brisket and it smelled wonderful. I was there during a lunch break at work on my tablet. Impressive southern and Jewish food menu.

negative.text: This establishment is a MUST GO TO. Everything on the menu is unreal. I have been here numerous times and I try something new every time I visit, with that being said, I am always blown away by what I try.
Very unorganized, poorly manage, was told wait time is 1 hour but in reality it's 2 hours

positive.text: I love the service and the decorations!!! I literally came all the way from California just to try this amazing restaurant! :D Shnitzel and Spatzel dish was so amazing! Pork was well cooked and well portioned! Definitely go try the nacho ice cream and the oreo cheese cake for the summer
Better come here! The food is so so so great! Friendly staff and great atmosphere inside! Ask for Todd for the free beer special!
Awesome food, wonderful, friendly service. Definitely recommend!! The prime rib was so good, delicious seasoning and cooked just right

negative.text: Definitely won't be back. Walked in, no one greeted my family and we had to wait to be seated in a virtually empty restaurant. They didn't have half of the food in that was on the menu and to top it off, it wasn't that great anyway.
IT"S NOT OPEN! Drove down to the restaurant, no where in this or other review sites did it say that it is closed. It appears they are remodeling because the sign says coming soon

positive.text: What a great restaurant Friendly staff Great beer selection Owner JB makes sure everyone welcome and happy with their experience Good German deli Interesting items to purchase Always a good time!

Oh my God, Mr. Dunderbak's was certainly something else. Great menu, Great atmosphere, Great service, and Great friends! The staff is really pleasant too. Everything we bought was superb and the menu itself was to die for. Can't wait to go back.
So good! Love me some sawsage! The best item on the menu, in my opinion, is the vonbom. It's huge and definitely shareable. Great beer selection. The owner and staff are super cool.

negative.text: Server was rude, all over the place, wasn't welcoming, took way to long for service, he showed no excitement, his attitude was giving off the vibe he wanted to go and not be there. That's why I didn't tip. Food good other wise not worth coming back. P.S. he had red mask, longer dirty blonde, short, stubby, white guy.
Drove one hour to see FC Bayern play in Champion's League Soccer final like I Always do. This time it sucks. Screen is set up wring. No sound. Staff seems indifferent. Should have stayed home!

positive.text: Great experience! Besides the far out reservation it was all worth the wait. Food is delicious, service is top tier, and the environment is great! Solomonov was there at the time and even came by to check on us. Very pleasant and kind. Made the experience that much better. Highly recommended

Absolutely great dinning experience! We dined in the yurt village they set up for COVID. It was perfectly warm and we felt very safe. Food from the fixed menu was AMAZING and an overwhelming portion. All four of us went home with left overs! Great service from Steve, and the community kitty was a welcome guest.
Amazing. Great service and unique menu. Great experience. Super flavorful and love going here for family and friends' birthdays. Must-try spot in Philly.

negative.text: Super exclusive. I always stay at the hotel near this area but can rarely get in. Great lamb!
Selling middle eastern food as Israeli food is called cultural appropriation. Do not support this business!

positive.text: Great service and great food. Our waiter Daniel was fantastic. He suggested great options and was so pleasant. I had the enchiladas and cherry margarita. It was so great: We truly enjoyed our experience and will come again.

It was your typical Mexican restaurant food, but still VERY good!! We ate here for a birthday dinner and enjoyed it thoroughly. The waiter was also very friendly and the atmosphere and decor was nice as well.

After a long stressful day at work I came to Rosalita's for a peaceful dinner. Gualberto provided excellent service. He was extremely courteous and polite. The happy hour here is great & the food is delicious! I will definitely be returning.

negative.text: It was soooo bad we went on a friday and it sucks man i got a burrito it was ice cold and my husband got the fajitas was nasty i would not tell people about this place?! Ugh

Too bad I can't give a negative star.(s). Food was nothing to write about and service was horrible was horrible. Dark corner of the bar area tables. Don't see myself going back. To top everything off was listening to the wait staff talk bad about the customers.

positive.text: Stopped in for lunch. Restaurant was busy but was immediately seated. Great service, great selection and great food. Waitress kept checking on me and had great recommendations. Had the White Chocolate Cashew Tart for dessert: it was amazing - it was HUGE , two people could share it and be full. Delicious.
Amazing amazing amazing Delicious delicious delicious My favorite place. Everything on the menu is fabulous!!! My birthday lunch celebration and my obsession for a weekly meal. Love this place!!

Had a great meal at Blue Sage tonight, but the best part of the evening was our amazing server, Jaimee. She was warm, friendly, professional, and knowledgable. Will definitely return because of her. (Oh, and the food was good, too!)

negative.text: Worst experience ever. Do not come here. After they said they would reserve a table we drove 30 minutes just to be told sorry we gave your table away. Never again.

Was pleasantly surprised to find out Blue Sage was doing outdoor dining. While the ambiance of sitting in the back of the building isn't fabulous, the food was as always. Disappointed the weather is getting cooler and this gem in the neighborhood will be hard to frequent.

positive.text: I got the skillet bibimbap and the rice was actually crispy! it looks small when it comes out, but it was heavily packed. It was amazing! The guy behind the register is super friendly and energetic. I would recommend this place to my out of town friends, and I'll definitely come back!

YES YES YES YES!!!! The best Asian fusion/Korean food I have had in Tennessee! We tried the hot chicken, chicken Korean taco, spicy pork Korean taco and the lettuce wraps, everything was amazing definitely should be a go to for some amazing flavorful food.

Our meal at soy bistro was awesome! The chicken tacos were loaded with juicy,tender chunks and the dumplings are cooked to crispy perfection. The teriyaki chicken was Delicious and a great portion. The owner and staff were very friendly and helpful with the menu. My family and friends new favorite asian restaurant!

negative.text: I like this place overall. Their tofu and Korean beef tacos are good. I've had the fish tacos but to me they weren't that great. Just know the parking is horrible and sitting is limited.

I ordered the traditional rice with chicken and it was delicious!! Also got one Korean taco and did not like it. However I will come back. The online menu seemed to not have the same things they had on their wall inside the restaurant... but no biggie.

positive.text: Wow! Came in on a snowy day for some tomato soup and baked Mac n Cheese - a perfect way to warm up with great comfort food. Was blown away by the food. The staff was great and loved the cozy feel. Definitely a place to enjoy near Old City.

This a truly lovely and popular brunch spot with lots of yummy choices. I managed to not order the monkey bread, but everyone else did and it looked delicious! Everyone at the table was satisfied with their meal. Would definitely recommend weekend reservations, as it is busy. The noise level is vibrant

This place is fantastic! The decor is 70s living room all the way. Very comfortable and inviting. The food is comfort food and it is delicious. My favorite item here is the lemongrass martini on the rocks. I will return again and again just for that drink.. never mind the Mac and cheese.. which is amazing!

negative.text: Hate this place , bad service ! Bad waitresses ! Racists . We waited for the dishes like 1 hour, just ordered two dishes , waited 0ne hour !
The food is reliably good, but today's hostess at lunch was unforgivably rude. When will the kids these days learn that being impolite to customers is not okay????!!!!!

positive.text: Amazing. I had the lobster ravioli and it was delicious. You only get 4 large raviolis, but the dish is so rich, it is plenty. We also tried the toasted ravioli which was super yummy as well. I recommended making a reservation because they seem to be pretty busy!

We flew into town today to celebrate my husbands birthday with family. We were greeted by an amazing host who was so friendly and even had us laugh several times throughout the night. The food, service and ambience was so amazing. I highly recommend this spot when in St Louis!!!
Great toasted ravioli. Great meatballs. Great cheese bread. Good salad. Great entree whatever it was. Average dessert. Great service.

negative.text: Walked in the door and was insulted because I had on a ball cap. Did not even have the chance to remove it Before being told to remove it because it's their policy and to remove my goat and put it in the coat check. Sorry but that is my choice if I choose to do that. We walked out very very rude. Will not be back.
Walked in. First time there. Very rude No ball caps for anyone even just walking in. And told to remove it and where to put our coats. Sorry. Not for me. Walked out.

positive.text: We tried again and were very pleased with the fantastic service, cleanliness, and food quality today. Refills were as needed, without having to ask. Everyone was very helpful and friendly, food came out in a timely manner and was beautifully presented and delicious. Thank you!

Ordered the Plantsgiving meal and it was delicious. Every part of the meal was done well. The pumpkin tamale for dessert was super yummy. I really appreciated that they made a entire plant based meal. Even though they are across town from me, I will be ordering from them again. Their staff is very friendly as well.
Wow, the best Mexican food in Tucson without a doubt. I love their side table guacamole too, so fun.

negative.text: We have eaten at el Charro numerous times and it has been good, but yesterday at lunch I got a mild case of food poisoning. One miserable evening. I haven't decided if we will ever go back.
We have eaten at el Charro numerous times and it has been good, but yesterday at lunch I got a mild case of food poisoning. One miserable evening. I haven't decided if we will ever go back.

positive.text: Amazing breakfast... the best meal we have had down here during multiple stays. Great view off the deck, amazing service. Well worth the 15 minute wait. Great value too...
We had a great breakfast here! Amazing views, giant portions, and good home cooking. It was wonderful and we will surely be back. Service was fantastic as well. :)

How fun!! The staff was so friendly and the view!!! Lucky they were not too busy when we went and we were seated immediately. The food was so good, everything was flavor full and well prepared. We didn't wait too long either. Great experience, we will definitely go back

negative.text: I am So SHOCKED at the reviews on here. May the lunch is better but breakfast was horrible. Boxed eggs, a waffle that was hard enough to be a waffle cone and food that looked like it came out the microwave. And to add the place was absolutely disgustingly filthy. I could never.

Good food, service was a bit slow and had to wait for a table but that's expected during this time. We had breakfast outside.. it was really warm, no breeze. They need to replace some of the umbrellas. Ours was broke and moldy. They don't have fountain soda, just cans, big disappointment for me. Food was average.

positive.text: Had a great experience! I ordered the pulled pork plate, cole slaw and sweet potato fries. Service was SO FAST. Meat very juicy, helpings very generous. Standard price! Love the aesthetic! Sweet potato fries were very crispy and delicious. I will be back happily.
Superb fast and friendly service. Amazingly clean. And the food. OMG. That is the best ultimate Reuben i have ever had!!! The BBQ nachos were delicious. Everything was absolutely amazing

Good experience! Had the brisket sandwich and cole slaw. The brisket was really tender and enjoyed the variety of six sauces!! The Dalies vinegar sauce was my fav. The cole slaw was good too! Staff was very friendly and accommodating.

negative.text: Really good but not stand out. By no means have I ever been disappointed. BBQ is niche thing these days and there are a lot of perspectives on what makes it good. I don't get too worked up about it but it's a solid joint.

The hush puppies are Food is always great and service is always fast. 1 negative thing: if you pull up to the window and place the order, the girls get annoyed and tell me "Make sure you call ahead if you want to use the window"

positive.text: Went for the first time yesterday and was lucky to get spot at the bar for the game. Happy hour is pretty good$ $5 titos $2 IPA and $2 off pizzas! Pizza is thin crust which I love and Capicola on it was great!!!! I would go back for sure! Great bartender service too!

Went to this restaurant for dinner and it was absolutely delicious! Sat inside comfortably distanced, quick service, clean establishment, and super kind and friendly staff. Food was absolutely delicious. I recommend the calamari!

Maybe I had the wrong food but I had the pizza and wings and craft beer. None of which I was impressed with. I give it OK but not worth the bad calories. Service was ok. Did not see and or Have any of the popular IPAs like space dust ,free dive , Lagunitas. Atmosphere was nice and it is downtown so it's overpriced !

negative.text: I just called about 5 minutes ago and the lady on the phone was very nasty to me. All I asked was about reservations and average wait times, I'm deeply disappointed. I also have had another experience with unfriendly waitstaff.
Had the worst experience...the staff was VERY rude and entitled! The food was marginal at best...Will not return:(

positive.text: Really good food! I got the beef huo fun (or chowfun) was really delicious! It had great flavor and good potion size. The salt and pepper squid was also very delicious. It's a great spot.

Excellent food, finally a great Chinese restaurant. We loved all the dishes . We noticed a lot of tables had the "silver bag" full of goodies. Looked really good . We tried two dishes an appetizer and a side dish . Service was great food was hot a delicious definitely coming back

Ok ok!! Second dine-in experience after the "Stay-Home".. here it goes! I really like the Crawfish Asian restaurant. The food is great and have excellent service. You should try the Salted Calamari, that's my favorite! Great for lunch or dinner. They have lunch specials as well. I highly recommend this place.

negative.text: My daughter and I just finished eating here and this was our first time. We were excited, unfortunately it was a huge disappointment. The customer service was terrible, we kept having to ask our server lemon and he forgot to put in my daughters order so we had to wait another hour to get her shrimp. Waste of money.

I come to Reno every 6 months for a week and always saw this place because it is near my hotel. Today first time I ordered chicken chaw mein to take out. It was horrible. Very greasy and the chicken was stale. I had to throw out half my dinner. Never going back.

positive.text: Que bueno!!! The beautiful vibrant and airy cafe emits sunshine vibes inside and out! The bright yellow portrays the mood of the cafe and crew that creates an awesome atmosphere. The food was seasoned to perfection and we had enough to take home! Was the very best and enjoyed by everyone:)

This is by far the place that has the best Cuban sandwich. I have tried many authentic Cuban sandwiches at amazing restaurants but hands down the BEST one. I am visiting for Labor day weekend and I might be back. Service was good, staff super friendly and the music was very pleasant.
Honestly loved loved their tacos and the classic margarita was so good! I think the spot is super cute and I would love to come back on a Tuesday to experience my taco Tuesday at a fun spot

negative.text: Disappointing. Got the wrong sandwich and the pork had no flavor. Grew up around authentic Cuban food and this food did not represent Cuban food very well. Overrated, another place putting shame to Latin food. We need authenticity!!!
Person at the window receiving orders has a bad attitude. If he doesn't like what he is doing he should not be taking orders. The food was prepared very fast.

positive.text: First time been here. And everything was so nice! Friendly funny waitress and of course delicious food! Omg the shrimp and crab meat pasta is the best pasta I have ever had. With creative spicy tomato sauce, it was literally covered with jumbo shrimps and crab meat. Love it!!!!!!!
We really enjoyed eating here. We celebrated a birthday with a friend. It was a fun time and being here made it special. The food was really good and we enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere of the place.

This place is amazing. Every time I go or order delivery it's so good. Love bringing family, guests or celebrating special occasions here. We always get the penne a la vodka and it's perfect each time. 100% recommend if you're in the West Chester area.

negative.text: Service here was terrible and staff members were rude and argumentative with our party as we were the paying customers. Unacceptable for a restaurant that holds itself to a certain standard. I have never been treated so disrespectfully. Never returning.
About one-step up from the Olive Garden so keep your expectations realistic. Absurdly huge portions drowning in sauce. Pleasant server but noise is a huge problem. One and done.

positive.text: so so yummy! i got the vegan sausage and tofu scramble. it is SO SO YUMMY. i got take out but the restaurant itself was super cute and the staff were all super friendly. i am moving here next year, and will definitely come more!! thank you!

Very busy but definitely worth the wait! I have only been here for Dinner and brews but both have been amazing. The food is delicious, unique and fairly priced. The variety of beers is excellent. I have had many great times with friends here.....once we got in of course!

This is the third time we eat here, and every time it's better than the previous one. Huevos Rancheros are delicious, Egg Benedict fantastic, chicken waffles just perfect and the coffee very creamy and delicious. Along with the wonderful atmosphere and friendly people, this place is one of the best.

negative.text: Seriously awful service- so awful I made a yelp account just so I could post this review! It's definitely not worth putting up with for the food. The hostess was unorganized and rude.
The last time we went to Sugar Bowl, and had the chicken waffles, the waffles were AWFUL. Poorly cooked, cold. Not really addressed by staff. Very disappointing

positive.text: Our second favorite sushi/Korean restaurant in Brandon! Their sushis are smaller than I'd like, but very good! The beef and pork bulgogi !! SO GOOD!! The pork I believe is very spicy, but yet very good. Their lunch special is also filling and the price is right! Cool atmosphere, good service, totally recommend!

I love this sushi place ! Soooo goood !!!!! The place is always clean ! & the service is great the employees are nice & takeout never seems to fail ! They always get my order on point ! The sushi is amazing so good ! My favorite ones are the California roll & st Patrick's roll ! So delicious

This is by far the best sushi I've had in years. The quality is amazing and I'm always so happy to eat here. Service is amazing. Recommend this place to everyone looking for sushi. The fish is always fresh and the chefs are so nice. Amazing gem in Brandon/Tampa area. Go before 2:30 for the lunch specials!

negative.text: Food average and service was poor. Our sever was eating with her back to us the entire time. Had to get up and ask for another drink and our dirty plates were never picked up.

The sushi really is NOT GOOD. I've eaten here more than once, trying to give it the benefit of the doubt. The krab rangoons and mochi are pretty good, but when it comes to sushi, it will most likely DISAPPOINT.

positive.text: Well the Collegeville one is much better but this has to do. Overall it's a good experience and it has comfy seats. The food is average and expensive, but definitely fun to order for the kids and eat before the movie starts. I just wish it was better kept up and cleaner.

I went in ready to be disappointed but was pleasantly surprised by how polite and accommodating the young staff was to my party of two. Food was delivered on time and as requested. Was pretty good, too. If it wasn't such a drive, I'd definitely go more often.
Great place to see a movie in a really comfy recliner and get tasty food and refreshment. $5 movie Tuesdays with free popcorn is the best! Service is usually very good.

negative.text: The theater is dirty, the food is awful, the drinks tasted contaminated, and the service is horrible to slow. The owners need to go there in disguise, walk through the dirty hallways (with popcorn everywhere on Tuesday), order food (disappointing) , taste the soda (nasty), and struggle to address the issues.

Awful experience. Went to the theater right at time and no one come to take order. Dozens of waiter/waitresses passing by and no one seems to "find" I am ready to take order......I went to this cinema several times but this is the new low. Terrible service!

positive.text: Wow, looking at this place you wouldn't have thought much of this hole in the wall, but this place is amazing! Best crab rangoon & drunken noodles we have ever eaten! The masaman curry is delicious and the Chão Praya Shrimp is a must! Reasonable prices and great customer service. A must of you're in Indianapolis!

Loved this place!! Chicken pad thai, panang curry, and the crab rangoons were all amazing!! Wasnt obsessed with the bangkok fried rice but still was pretty good. My boyfriend and I totally recommend it!

Been looking for a go-to Thai spot near our near home and we have FOUND it! Great food for a great price. We love the pad thai and you can't go wrong with any of the curry dishes We're excited to try the rest of the menu in the coming weeks!

negative.text: Salade is good. Thom yum is very bad. The chef was reluctant to put enough sauce and seasoning, and it didn't even contain Thai eggplant. Thom yum is , after all , the most typical Thai food. I can not understand why is so bad.
Recently ate here and the food was very average service was poor. A big disappointment from my first visit there years ago.

positive.text: This place is amazing, smallish for seating but amazing food selection, shrimp and grits were perfectly seasoned and very well portioned. Shrimp and crab omelette is the best we have ever had! Will make this a great stop when in the Big Easy. Music selections and staff were very friendly and acc

The pancakes for the big easy breakfast was amazing I loved the pancake batter used for it. The sweet tea was good as well. The hash browns were very seasoned. The service was great and the food was worth the wait. My girlfriend enjoyed her farmer's omelet as well. The whole meal was delicious.

One of the best sit down brunch places! AMAAAZING FRENCH TOAST. The kitchen here are all fun and happy, and I love going places where employees are happy. The wait is worth it, we came on a Saturday so it's understandable and worth it Pancakes are nice and fluffy, the bacon and has browns are great too!

negative.text: Stopped in based on a recommendation of a local. It was worth it. The grits are to die for...there wasn't a huge line or wait either- which was a major issue with most of the places we stopped by during our stay. The Bloody Mary was good too!
Just ok. The food was ok... Nothing great. The waitress was not good. I would not eat here again nor would I recommend this restaurant.

positive.text: Food was great, but the best part to me was the service. Our waiter went out of his way to make sure we enjoyed our experience and was extremely helpful when dealing with my son's food allergies. I know that this isn't important to everyone, but he was super attentive to everything during our experience!

The food was really good but the service was excellent. Our server/waiter, Connor was truly knowledgeable about menu items and very good about serving his guests. I would definitely go back again. We had a wonderful experience.

Our server, Asia, was EXCELLENT! She made the entire experience. These were also the best fried pickles AND cheese grits I've ever had. The sriracha honey chicken was super spicy, but so good with the sweet waffle. Wonderful dining experience overall!

negative.text: I will give this place a 0 star if I could! Service was HORRENDOUS, waitress was rude, never delivered condiments requested, I had to ask four times for a glass of water. She brought the wrong beer, never make a trip back to out table to check how things were going. Food was bad. Will never EVER come back!!!
No stars. Service was very slow and no hospitality. Would not recommend to anyone. No recommendations, completely disappoint

positive.text: Went on a Saturday weekend and enjoyed a late lunch. Tried a few of their beer and I enjoyed all of them. I definitely want to go back and try some more. Food was great, loved the nacho! My cauliflower curry tacos were great. And their burger was solid. Definitely want to come back to try more things!
Great beers Busy crowded on weekends I live their small plates Beers not my specialty but my friends said they were strong and good Overall fun time!

Great spot for craft beer and good food. The beer is great and the atmosphere is chill. Reasonable prices for food and beer but would recommend getting a reservation on the weekends because the wait can be long. Friendly staff and overall a great experience.

negative.text: I have never experienced rudeness like my experience just now at tired hands. Even worse, when I asked to speak with the manager, the gentleman who was so incredible rude- turns out he was the manager.
Grunge staff , really annoying Not a fan of the beer, I know I'm a loser. Too many other places to spend my money Won't be back for a while

positive.text: This is a really great, local bar and grill. They serve ice cream and are located right on the beach. Hudson beach isn't flashy but it's nice and it's a good place to get away for a few hours and have fun without spending too much.. I recommend the seafood bucket, it's literally amazing and I love it a ton.
Great location, love it!!! Food is good, fried dish not that great. Shrimp pot is huge portion and tasty, Nacho bbq is huge and yummy. Service is great as well. Overall is a great place.
Great place for dinner on the beach, good drinks and service was great, food is good , best nachos we ever had so far, friendly staff, would definitely recommend this restaurant for lunch or dinner,

negative.text: Bought 2 shirts over 50.00 never wore have receipt. Girl gave me xl instead of 2x. Won't exchange. Ripoffs!!!! Beware what you buy spending big money!!! Won't honor products. Says cause covid can't return. Well stores does!!! Piss poor

We've visited Sam's a few times now and had bad experiences each time. Food is overpriced, staff is not the friendliest, they all seem stressed and rushed too. The wait for a table is always excessive and unorganized. We will not be back.

positive.text: The menu is always changing, but good god is the food delicious. Really delicious and varying meat-centric dishes. Great place to get a bunch of stuff and share.
The food was really wonderful as well as the staff. The drinks are strong and the vibe is perfect. Great for business, date night or just a great place to grab a great bite

Great place for lunch! I got a Le Pig Mac (sing the jingle but substitue beef for pork): very clean tasting, got a nice spice to it, and extremely filling. Good drinks too, as I got a frozen Mai Thai which complimented it perfectly.

negative.text: This is a must have if your in New Orleans .... The pork belly sandwich is to die for..
Best sandwiches ever. The Buck Board Bacon Melt is to die for! I stop in when ever I visit NOLA!!!
